Title: BCV Governor's Speech
text: Opening speech of the SEMINAR ATTF Page 1 of 2 Intervention of the Governor at the opening of the ATTF seminar Senhor Administrator Mr Pierre Bultez Representatives of financial institutions Ladies and Gentlemen Participants It is with some enthusiasm that I proceed to the opening of this seminar aimed at raising awareness of the problem of life insurance in our country. This awareness-raising action follows others already carried out by the Bank of Cape Verde as part of its policy of training and information of actors in the financial sector, with a view to creating an environment conducive to the development of the financial system. This seminar is organised in partnership with the Financial Technology Transfer Agency (ATTF) within the framework of the existing cooperation between the Cape Verde replica and Luxembourg. This partnership, initiated in 2001, has already allowed the participation of more than two hundred Cape Verdean frameworks from various quarters, but with predominance for the banking and financial area, in twelve courses and seminars of short and medium duration, in which several topics were addressed, with special emphasis on the management of banking, banking techniques and practices, the prevention of money laundering, micro-finance and training of trainers. The choice, this time, of a theme on the insurance sector is the recognition of the importance of this sector in the country's economy, and at the same time mirrors the bcv's concern about the need to invest in the boosting and growth of this sector, and the life sector can serve as an important driver. Life insurance is an ancient practice -histia situates the first practices of compensation in kind and in cash, which are at the origin of the insurance - life, in the 2nd century BC in Babilia and , a few decades later, in Greece and Rome - and is present everywhere in the world. It is in the most advanced economies as well as in developing economies. As a general rule, there seems to be a correlation between the level of eco-development of a country and the level of life insurance in that country. Indeed, while in developing countries insurance activity focuses mainly on non-life branches, the premiums charged by insurance companies in the life insurance sector account for around 2/3 of the total insurance premiums in OECD countries. It is important to mention the ecological and social relevance of life insurance. From an individual point of view, the 15-09-2010 Opening speech of the seminary ATTF Page 2 of 2 life insurance offers several advantages. The insurance, in case of death, guarantees the family the payment of a certain sum at the time of the subscriber's death. It thus represents a means of protection against the financial consequences of premature death. In case of life, insurance is also a means of saving for the individual. Life insurance products and in particular incomes are a safe means of financially preparing retirement. In addition, life insurance allows borrowers, individuals and businesses to borrow in more favorable conditions and reduces the risk of default. In society's tics, insurance companies operating in the life sector, such as financial intermediaries, help mobilize savings to support investment with long-term resources, favoring the acceleration of eco-growth. On the other hand, individual insurance underwriting relieves the pressure on social protection schemes, thereby reducing the tax necessary to maintain these schemes. These advantages explain that most OECD countries have consented to special tax advantages for the underwriting, maintenance or execution of life insurance apices, with a view to favouring a reorientation of savings for the benefit of life insurance. In Cape Verde, the life business has so far had a weak expression, representing the premiums of this industry, in average terms, just over 1% of the total premiums charged by insurers. As conditioning this situation, several reasons are pointed out, highlighting the competition of other systems of individual and social protection; the absence of tax incentives; the low level of income of most Cape Verdeans that makes it difficult to access a supplementary social security system, the weak development of the insurance culture, and perhaps the weak involvement of insurers in this negio industry that do not seem to dominate sufficiently. Despite these constraints, we think that the life branch holds a promise and that there are significant potentialities for its development. From the outset, those resulting from the combination of the future reform of the penss regime with the emergence of social layers with a relatively high level of income. But housing credit can also be a fertile ground for the development of life insurance because of its size and dynamics. I therefore hope that this action to raise awareness of the problem of life insurance will serve to boost the creation of conditions, both in terms of legal infrastructure and incentives, as well as in management and marketing, for the development of business problems in Cape Verde.
text_original: Discurso de abertura do seminario ATTF Page 1 of 2 Interveno do Governador na abertura do seminrio ATTF Senhor Administrador Senhor Pierre Bultez Senhores Representantes das Instituis Financeiras Senhoras e Senhores Participantes  com algum entusiasmo que procedo  abertura deste seminrio destinado a sensibilizar os intervenientes sobre a problemtica do seguro vida no nosso pas. Esta aco de sensibilizao vem na sequncia de outras j realizadas pelo Banco de Cabo Verde no mbito da sua poltica de formao e informao dos intervenientes no sector financeiro, visando a criao de um ambiente propcio para o desenvolvimento do sistema financeiro. Este seminrio  organizado em parceria com a Agncia de Transferncia de Tecnologia Financeira (ATTF), no quadro da cooperao existente entre a Replica de Cabo Verde e Luxemburgo. Essa parceria, iniciada em 2001, j permitiu a participao de mais de duas centenas de quadros cabo-verdianos provenientes de diversos quadrantes, mas com predominncia para a rea bancria e financeira, em doze cursos e seminrios de curta e mdia durao, nos quais foram tratados diversos temas, com especial destaque para os versando sobre a gesto da banca, as tcnicas e prticas bancrias, a preveno do branqueamento de capitais, as micro-finanas e a formao de formadores. A escolha, desta vez, de um tema sobre o sector segurador  o reconhecimento da importncia deste sector na economia do pas, e, simultaneamente, espelha a preocupao do BCV com a necessidade de se investir na dinamizao e no crescimento deste sector, podendo o ramo vida servir como um impulsionador importante. O seguro de vida  uma prtica antiga -a histia situa as primeiras prticas de compensao em espcie e em dinheiro, que esto na origem do seguro  vida, no 2 sculo A.C. na Babilia e ,algumas dcadas depois, na Grcia e em Roma -e est presente em toda parte no mundo. Encontra-se nas economias as mais avanadas bem como nas economias em desenvolvimento. Regra geral, parece existir uma correlao entre o nvel de desenvolvimento econico de um pas e o nvel do seguro vida nesse pas. Com efeito, enquanto nos pases em desenvolvimento a actividade seguradora concentra-se principalmente nos ramos no vida, os prmios cobrados pelas companhias seguradoras no ramo do seguro vida representam nos pases da OCDE cerca dos 2/3 do total dos prmios de seguro. Importa referir a relevncia econica e social do seguro vida. Do ponto de vista individual, o http://www.bcv.cv/_conteudo/intervencao/governador/2004/ig20042510.htm 15-09-2010 Discurso de abertura do seminario ATTF Page 2 of 2 seguro vida oferece vrias vantagens. O seguro, em caso de morte, garante  famlia o pagamento de uma determinada soma no momento da morte do subscritor. Representa, assim, um meio de proteco contra as consequncias financeiras de uma morte prematura. Em caso de vida, o seguro  tambm um meio de poupana para o indivduo. Os produtos do seguro vida e em particular as rendas so um meio seguro de preparar financeiramente a reforma. Ademais, o seguro vida permite aos muturios, particulares e empresas, contrair emprstimos em condis mais favorveis e reduz o risco de incumprimento. Na tica da sociedade, as companhias de seguro que operam no ramo vida, como intermedirios financeiros, ajudam a mobilizar a poupana para suportar o investimento com recursos de longo prazo, favorecendo a acelerao do crescimento econico. Por outro lado, a subscrio individual de seguros alivia as presss sobre os regimes de proteco social, reduzindo assim o imposto necessrio  manuteno destes regimes. Estas vantagens explicam que a maioria dos pases da OCDE tenha consentido vantagens fiscais especiais para a subscrio, a manuteno ou a execuo de apices de seguro vida, com vista a favorecer uma reorientao da poupana em benefcio do seguro vida. Em Cabo Verde, o ramo vida tem tido at  presente data uma fraca expresso, representando os prmios deste ramo, em termos mdios, pouco mais de 1% do total dos prmios cobrados pelas seguradoras. Como condicionando esta situao so apontadas vrias razs, destacando-se a concorrncia de outros sistemas de proteco individual e social; a inexistncia de incentivos fiscais; o baixo nvel dos rendimentos da maioria dos cabo-verdianos que dificulta o acesso a um sistema complementar de segurana social, o fraco desenvolvimento da cultura seguradora, e qui o fraco envolvimento das seguradoras neste ramo de negio que no parecem dominar suficientemente. No obstante esses constrangimentos, pensamos que o ramo vida encerra uma promessa e que existem significativas potencialidades para o seu desenvolvimento. Desde logo, as resultantes da conjugao da futura reforma do regime de penss com a emergncia de camadas sociais com um nvel relativamente elevado de rendimentos. Mas tambm o crdito  habitao pode constituir, pela sua dimenso e dinmica, um terreno frtil para o desenvolvimento do seguro vida. Por isso, fao votos que esta aco de sensibilizao  problemtica dos seguros de vida sirva para impulsionar a criao de condis, tanto a nvel da infra-estrutura legal e dos incentivos, como a nvel da gesto e do marketing, para o desenvolvimento de negios no ramo vida em Cabo Verde. http://www.bcv.cv/_conteudo/intervencao/governador/2004/ig20042510.htm 15-09-2010

Title: BCV Governor's Speech
text: Governor's intervention in launching visa page 1 of 3 service Intervention of the Governor in the Act of Official Launch of the VISA Service Prime Minister Minister for Finance and Planning Mr Representative of VISA International Members of the Board of Directors of SISP Ladies and Gentlemen It is with particular pride and satisfaction that I participate in this act of official launch of the VISA service in Cape Verde, as Governor of bcv, for all the commitment and labor that this institution has been putting, together with the various partners involved, in this great project of modernization of the Cape Verdean Payment System, under way since 1996, but also as cape Verdean, achieving a goal widely pursued and desired by various sectors of the Cape Verdean economy, from banking to tourism. The journey and the journey trodden to the culmination of this great goal for the financial system and for the entire Cape Verdean economy was not easy, surely, but fulfilled the objective, we cannot fail to affirm how significant this moment is, particularly in terms of the consecration of an effective strategic partnership between national and foreign institutions and between plicas and private entities, pursuing a plan of capital interest for the country. In good time, it should be said, the national banking community, under the leadership of the Bank of Cape Verde as regulator, supervisor and promoter of the proper functioning of compensation and payment systems, decided on the basis of a broad institutional cooperation, to put our hands on the creation of this great project to and from Cape Verde that began with the signing of the Protocol  between the BCV, Treasury and credit institutions  which created an Interbank Commission for the Payment System (CISP), and through which several initiatives were developed, the most important of which was the creation of the Interbank and Payment System Company (SISP) and which has been to obviate the emergence of the interbank network of vinti4 electric payment services. Today, the main objective of the project has been fulfilled, because it should be in mind that the creation of SISP and the Vinti4 Network, within the framework of the extensive programme for modernising the national payment system, much more than the domestic aspect dedicated to the implementation and operation of an electric payment system, will have complied with broader requirements that indicated the need to create the minimum conditions for the acceptance of international payment carts, as a way to enhance the development of tourism and maximize revenuestemmed from the sector, by providing payment facilities to tourists and men of negio who demand these islands. 15-09-2010 Governor's intervention at the launch of the Visa Page 2 of 3 service Therefore, expectations are doubled regarding the impacts that the presence of an important brand, and world leader in the segment of electric payments, such as VISA, may have on the national financial system and improving the performance of our economy, from the perspective of its internationalization, and in view of the contribution that the financial sector is expected to its development. From the outset, with visa's presence in Cape Verde, today a reality, the country, particularly its financial system, scores points in terms of credibility and image at international level. On the other hand, the support of Visa Internacional, with regard to Tourism, brings new hope for such an important sector for the country, mainly due to the predictable effects of the Balance of Payments (BP). In fact, the acceptance of international credit cards across the national electric payment infrastructure  ATMs and automatic payment terminals (POS) of the Vinti4 Network  is expected to be accompanied by an increase in tourist spending in the national territory that could result in the increase in tourism's weight in gross domestic product (GDP), the structural deficit of our current account and, at the same time, to allow greater control of the country's currencies. Ladies and Gentlemen The country has taken another important step towards its ecological and social development, but the path still to be taken should not be underestimated. On the part of the Bank of Cape Verde, with the same commitment that we lend to the fulfillment of our other missiles and attributes, we will continue to promote the development of the Cape Verdean Payment System with the intention of making it a factor of competitiveness of the national economy and an instrument of insertion in the world economy, taking into account not our statutory attributions, but especially because payment systems are now unanimously regarded as the vital system  "the heart"  of the banking sector, on which the good conduct of monetary policy depends, the expansion of the provision of financial services and the efficiency and development of the economy. In this scenario, we reiterate our propitium and engagement in the continuous and regular promotion of initiatives and partnerships that contribute to the development of the national payment system, which are based on a strong cooperative nature, because the experience we have just witnessed tells us that only by combining the efforts will we achieve the objectives we desire. I take the opportunity to inform those present, in the manner of good news, that the Bank of Cape Verde at the end of 2004 decided to set up a Coordination Commission for the Development of the Payment System in order to strengthen institutional cooperation, an added value that has always been the basis for the development of the system, both in the strategic and operational aspects, so that with the same spirit that so far significant advances have been made  and that brings us here 15-09-2010 Governor's intervention in the launch of visa page 3 of 3 service today  we can continue this process of consolidation and modernization of the different structures that make up our payment system, responding satisfactorily to the challenges that we have yet to overcome and which are fundamentally through integrated and concerted interventions around three strategic axes: i) Strengthening the superintendence of the payment system by the Bank of Cape Verde, both in the area of regulation and supervision of the different subsystems, as well as in the implementation of an Integrated Project for Information Management and Technological Infrastructure (PIGIT). ii) Consolidation of the treasury banking process, aiming at greater state participation in existing interbank infrastructure; (iii) and the permanent modernisation and updating of the infrastructure, services and payment instruments that are made available to the banking population (and to be banked). The Integrated Project for Information Management and Technological Infrastructure (PIGIT), in turn, will be embodied in the development and operationalization of three important mules: -Telecompensacao de Cheques System; -Interbank Electric Transfer System; -Depitos and Liquidation Management System. As we celebrate this important milestone, we are therefore already working on future steps. I would conclude, addressing a word of deep gratitude and gratitude to all those who have lent, and continue to lend, their contribution to this project of modernization of the Cape Verdean payment system, of which SISP and the Vinti4 Network are only a part, asking you for permission to highlight, for the sake of justice, the competence, effort and selfless dedication of the entire SISP team, headed by its Director-General. Deserves to be mentioned at this point Banco de Portugal, for the technical support and assistance since the start of the project, and also the World Bank whose financing contributed to the feasibility of the project. To all the traditional partners of the Bank of Cape Verde, especially credit institutions, I call on us to continue to have the necessary courage and this spirit of mission to continue serving Cape Verde and the Cape Verdeans in the ever-present challenge of continuing with the desideratation of the modernization of our payment system, an indispensable condition of the desired ecological development. Thank you very much. 15-09-2010
text_original: Interveno do governador no lanamento do servio Visa Page 1 of 3 Interveno do Governador no Acto de Lanamento Oficial do Servio VISA Senhor Primeiro-ministro Senhor Ministro das Finanas e Planeamento Senhor Representante da VISA Internacional Senhores Membros do Conselho de Administrao da SISP Minhas Senhoras e Meus Senhores  com particular orgulho e satisfao que participo neste acto de lanamento oficial do servio VISA em Cabo Verde, como Governador do BCV, por todo o empenho e labor que esta instituio vem colocando, juntamente com os diversos parceiros envolvidos, neste grande projecto de modernizao do Sistema de Pagamentos Cabo-verdiano, em curso desde 1996, mas tambm como cabo-verdiano, pela concretizao de um objectivo largamente perseguido e desejado por vrios sectores da economia cabo-verdiana, da banca ao turismo. O percurso e o trajecto trilhados at se chegar ao culminar desta grande meta para o sistema financeiro e para toda a economia cabo-verdiana, no foi fcil, seguramente, mas cumprido o objectivo, no podemos deixar de afirmar o quo significativo  este momento, particularmente em termos de consagrao de uma eficaz parceria estratgica entre instituis nacionais e estrangeiras e entre entidades plicas e privadas, na prossecuo de um desgnio de interesse capital para o pas. Em boa hora, diga-se, a comunidade bancria nacional, sob a liderana do Banco de Cabo Verde enquanto regulador, fiscalizador e promotor do bom funcionamento dos sistemas de compensao e de pagamentos, decidiu com base numa ampla cooperao institucional, lanar mos  obra na criao deste grandioso projecto de e para Cabo Verde que comeou pela assinatura do Protocolo  entre o BCV, Tesouro e instituis de crdito  que criou uma Comisso Interbancria para o Sistema de Pagamentos (CISP), e atravs do qual foram desenvolvidas diversas iniciativas, a mais importante das quais foi a criao da Sociedade Interbancria e Sistema de Pagamentos (SISP) e que veio obviar o aparecimento da rede interbancria de servios de pagamentos electricos Vinti4. Hoje, cumpriu-se, efectivamente, o objectivo fulcral do projecto, pois, importa ter presente que a criao da SISP e da Rede Vinti4, no quadro do vasto programa de modernizao do sistema de pagamentos nacional, muito mais do que a vertente domstica vocacionada para a implementao e a operacionalizao de um sistema electrico de pagamentos, ter obedecido a imperativos de mbito mais alargado que apontavam no sentido da necessidade de se criar as condis mnimas para a aceitao de carts de pagamentos internacionais, como forma de potenciar o desenvolvimento do turismo e maximizar as receitas provenientes do sector, pela via da disponibilizao de facilidades de pagamentos aos turistas e homens de negio que demandam estas ilhas. http://www.bcv.cv/_conteudo/intervencao/governador/2005/ig20050501.htm 15-09-2010 Interveno do governador no lanamento do servio Visa Page 2 of 3 Por isso, abrem-se redobradas expectativas relativamente aos impactos que a presena de uma importante marca, e lder mundial no segmento de pagamentos electricos, como o  a VISA, poder ter no sistema financeiro nacional e na melhoria da performance da nossa economia, na perspectiva da sua internacionalizao, e tendo em vista o contributo que do sector financeiro se espera ao seu desenvolvimento. Desde logo, com a presena da VISA em Cabo Verde, hoje uma realidade, o pas, particularmente o seu sistema financeiro, marca pontos em termos de credibilidade e imagem a nvel internacional. Por outro lado, a adeso  Visa Internacional, no que ao Turismo diz respeito, vem trazer novas esperanas para to importante sector para o pas, fundamentalmente, pelos efeitos previsveis ao nvel da Balana de Pagamentos (BP). De facto, espera-se que a aceitao de carts de crdito internacionais em toda a infra-estrutura electrica de pagamentos nacional  caixas automticas (ATM) e terminais de pagamento automtico (POS) da Rede Vinti4  seja acompanhada por um aumento das despesas dos turistas no territio nacional que possa traduzir-se no aumento do peso do Turismo no Produto Interno Bruto (PIB), na atenuao do dfice estrutural da nossa conta corrente e, simultaneamente, possibilitar um maior controlo das divisas do pas. Minhas Senhoras e Meus Senhores O pas deu mais um importante passo em prol do seu desenvolvimento econico e social, mas o caminho ainda a percorrer no deve ser subestimado. Da parte do Banco de Cabo Verde, com o mesmo empenho que emprestamos ao cumprimento das nossas outras nossas misss e atribuis, continuaremos a promover o desenvolvimento do Sistema de Pagamentos Cabo-verdiano com o fito de dele fazer um factor de competitividade da economia nacional e um instrumento de insero na economia mundial, atendendo no ss nossas atribuis estatutrias, mas especialmente porque, actualmente, os sistemas de pagamentos so unanimemente considerados como o sistema vital  o corao  do sector bancrio, do qual depende a boa conduo da poltica monetria, o alargamento da oferta de servios financeiros e a eficincia e o desenvolvimento da economia. Neste cenrio, reiteramos o nosso propito e engajamento na promoo contnua e regular de iniciativas e parcerias que concorram para o desenvolvimento do sistema de pagamentos nacional, que tenham por base um forte cariz cooperativo, pois, a experincia que acabamos de testemunhar diz-nos que somente conjugando os esforos conseguiremos alcanar os objectivos que desejamos. Aproveito o ensejo para informar aos presentes, em jeito de boas novas, que o Banco de Cabo Verde nos finais de 2004 decidiu criar uma Comisso de Coordenao para o Desenvolvimento do Sistema de Pagamentos visando reforar a cooperao institucional, uma mais-valia que esteve sempre na base do desenvolvimento do sistema, quer na vertente estratgica, quer na vertente operacional, para que com o mesmo esprito que at agora se conseguiu avanos significativos  e que nos traz aqui http://www.bcv.cv/_conteudo/intervencao/governador/2005/ig20050501.htm 15-09-2010 Interveno do governador no lanamento do servio Visa Page 3 of 3 hoje  se possa continuar este processo de consolidao e modernizao das diferentes estruturas que compm o nosso sistema de pagamentos, respondendo satisfatoriamente aos desafios que ainda temos que vencer e que passam, fundamentalmente, por intervens integradas e concertadas em torno de trs eixos estratgicos: i) Reforo da superintendncia do sistema de pagamentos pelo Banco de Cabo Verde, tanto no domnio da regulao e fiscalizao dos diferentes subsistemas, como ainda na implementao de um Projecto Integrado de Gesto de Informao e Infra estruturao Tecnolica (PIGIT). ii) Consolidao do processo de bancarizao do Tesouro, visando uma maior participao do Estado na infra-estrutura interbancria existente; iii) E modernizao e actualizao tecnolica permanente das infra-estruturas, servios e instrumentos de pagamentos que so colocados  disposio da populao bancria (e a bancarizar). O Projecto Integrado de Gesto de Informao e Infra estruturao Tecnolica (PIGIT), por sua vez, ser consubstanciado no desenvolvimento e operacionalizao de trs importantes mulos: -Sistema de Telecompensao de Cheques; -Sistema de Transferncias Electricas Interbancrias; -Sistema de Gesto de Depitos e Liquidao. Ao comemorarmos este importante marco, estamos, pois, j a trabalhar nos passos futuros. Finalizaria, endereando uma palavra de profundo agradecimento e reconhecimento a todos quantos emprestaram, e continuam emprestando, o seu contributo a este projecto de modernizao do sistema de pagamentos cabo-verdiano, de que a SISP e a Rede Vinti4 so apenas uma parte, pedindo-vos a permisso para realar, por uma questo de justia, a competncia, o esforo e a dedicao abnegada de toda a equipa da SISP, chefiada pelo seu Director Geral. Merece ser neste momento mencionado o Banco de Portugal, pelo apoio e assistncia tcnicos desde o arranque do projecto, e ainda o Banco Mundial cujo financiamento contribuiu  viabilizao do projecto. A todos os parceiros tradicionais do Banco de Cabo Verde, especialmente s instituis de crdito, apelo a que continuemos a ter a coragem necessria e este esprito de misso de continuar a servir Cabo Verde e os cabo-verdianos no desafio sempre presente de prosseguir com o desiderato da modernizao do nosso sistema de pagamentos, condio indispensvel do almejado desenvolvimento econico. Muito obrigado. http://www.bcv.cv/_conteudo/intervencao/governador/2005/ig20050501.htm 15-09-2010

Title: Speech on the occasion of the 1st Meeting of Governors of the Banks
text: Untitled Document Page 1 of 2 Speech by the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde delivered on the occasion of the 1st Meeting of Governors of the Central Banks of portuguese countries and Macao held Beach, 27/02/04 First of all, I would like to tell you how honoured we are with the initiative of holding, in Cape Verde and in this city of Praia, the First Meeting of Governors of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries and Macao. I would therefore like to greet, on my own behalf and on behalf of my colleagues on the Board of Directors of the Bank of Cape Verde, all present and address warm ly to the different delegations of the central banks who have deigned to embrace this initiative which we wish to be a time of joint search for resolutions to the specific problems of our countries, management of monetary policy, ensuring sustained economic growth. Many have come from afar, but the bonds that unite us are actually stronger than the turbulence that a trip always encloses. Our determination, to place one more stone, another piece of our soul in the process of consolidating the CPLP and the relationship between this tima and Macau, through an open and genuine discussion space, of the central banks speaking of Portuguese - I would like to stress, Portuguese speakers - is unbeatable and indomant. Our central banks have produced enough evidence in this regard. We will certainly continue to work in the areas of money laundering, consolidated supervision and exchanges of statistical information and knowledge. We are, in fact, Speakers of Portuguese and the language is communication, it is affirmation and an exposure to others of what we are. And here, globalization is certainly an invitation to affirm differences and we believe, yes, and increasingly, that language unites us. Histia determined it. The presence of the CPLP in the world, its usefulness as a political instrument for the states that constitute it, lies in the language. Their strength and interest will result from the summation of each country's individuality and the joint affirmation of its capabilities to be a voice in the international community. Our relationship - the relationship between the Portuguese-Speaking Countries and Macao should not be seen as just another historical consequence, but as a growing and valuable patrimio that we want to voluntarily preserve and develop. The political capital existing in 200 million people, spread over twelve time zones, and three oceans, can not be wasted. In fact, we should not lose sight of the fact that the wealth potential of this linguistic space is there. The discoveries of petreo and gas reserves off Angola and S. Tome and Principe continue to grow. International investors' attention is turning back to the ports of Maputo and Nacala and to the exploitation of heavy sands in Mozambique, where significant annual growth rates have been observed. 15-09-2010 Untitled Document Page 2 of 2 International investments are aggressively positioned in the area of construction and plica in Angola. European entrepreneurs are looking for new tourist opportunities in Cape Verde. Macau is an open door to the world production center. And Timor has enormous growth potential. All this and more are realities that we cannot be inattentive to. The added value of language and culture allows us to position ourselves  all with comparative advantages in these markets. An effort is also needed to increase contacts between civil society in the CPLP and Macao. The community cannot be just an emanation of governments. It is precisely in this context that this Meeting of Governors of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries and Macao emerges. This initiative aims only to create another space for debate, reflection and sharing of experience and knowledge among our central banks. This meeting will include: A Round Table restricted to central banks, subject to the theme "Monetary Policy and Real Economy", since the issue of monetary policy and its transmission mechanisms, with emphasis, inter alia, on the coherence of the monetary regime, clear definition of its objectives, design of effective instruments, as well as the necessary communication policy, has been the subject of heated debate, also in our countries; and a conference open to civil society, subject to the theme: "The Portuguese Economy against the Euro". Since the process of adapting to the Euro is one of the main challenges and opportunities facing the Portuguese and European economy at the moment, it is important that our central banks promote a growing dialogue with civil society regarding the implications of this process for our respective economies. Since there are experiences within the CPLP and Macao of monetary regimes  including: monetary union, monetary zone, currency board, almost dollarization and free fluctuation we would like us to, by properly exploiting this asset, we would seek from our experience the lessons to better be able to face the challenges of management and development of our monetary regimes with which each of our central banks are faced. We wish you a good stay in this beach city and in this country and we all hope that tomorrow we will remember this meeting as a work that has remained. 15-09-2010
text_original: Untitled Document Page 1 of 2 Discurso do governador do Banco de Cabo Verde proferido por ocasio do 1 Encontro de Governadores dos Bancos Centrais dos Pases de Expresso Portuguesa e Macau realizado Praia, 27-02-04 Quero, em primeiro lugar, dizer-vos o quanto nos sentimos honrados com a iniciativa da realizao, em Cabo Verde e nesta cidade da Praia, do Primeiro Encontro de Governadores dos Bancos Centrais de Pases de Expresso Portuguesa e Macau. Title: Speech at the opening of the 1st Assembly
text: Untitled Document Page 1 of 2 Speech of the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde delivered at the opening of the work of the 1st Constitutive Assembly of the Federation of Cape Verdean Microcredit Associations Beach, 04/03/04 Ladies and gentlemen of the Constituent Assembly Bureau, Dear Guests, First of all, I would like to thank you for the honorable invitation addressed to me to preside over the opening of the work of the constitution of the Federation of Cape Verdean Microcredit Associations and to welcome with great satisfaction the holding of such an important event. After five years of exemplary work of the OGNS operating in the area of microfinance, which translates into the support and increase of activities that generate employment and income to the most deprived populations of the various municipalities of our country, this is the time for its 1st Constitutive Assembly. The Bank of Cape Verde fully assumes its role as a bank of a developing country with enormous structural problems. According to ine data, 36 percent of the Cape Verdean resident population is poor, 20 percent very poor and 16 percent poor, meaning more than 160,000 Cape Verdean souls spend less than 120 00 a day. The poet Ovidio Martins said "we learned from the wind to dance in disgrace and the goats taught us to eat stones so we wouldn't perish." Poverty remains more pronounced in rural areas where just over half of the population is poor, about 51 pc, and 30 out of every 100 people in this area of residence are very poor. The incidence of poverty is also higher among families headed by women and among those whose boss is unemployed. In order to combat this evil, in its human and monetary aspect, we must overcome the culture of "asking". With an economy growing at 5 pct rates, the population can't expect another circuit. The poor ask the government and the government asks international partners. This culture is blocking, but it still exists in certain political, institutional and civil society segments. What it takes, really, is to do. In this context, we need to open spaces for the incubation of dynamic, productive and competitive micro and small enterprises. But also without proper organization, this mission is impossible. The emerging economy at the end of the century is based mainly on ideas, more than on capital or commodities. But idealists, especially the "little ones" rarely have guarantees for funders. However, the successful experiences in many sio-econic realities of different countries have proven that low-income families, despite their poverty, are trustworthy and that access to credit is an important tool for promoting micro-enterprise. Micro-finance is indeed an important tool for providing financial services to the poorest sections of the population, devoid of financial support and without access to the financial services of a traditional bank, enabling them to start their business and provide their income. Although the practice of microfinance in Cape Verde is a relatively recent pheneno, debating with the scarcity of resources and dependence on external donors, it has been gaining 15-09-2010 Untitled Document Page 2 of 2 however institutional contours, quantitative importance and important social and ecological role in the context of the fight against poverty, thanks to the meritorious work of NGOs. It is important to densify and consolidate this experience, innovating. It is necessary to gain scale, funding, competence and dimension. So let me propose to you the creation of a Solidarity Bank that would take care of a segment where banks are absent, promote independent employment, promote the development of all growth-bearing factors and participate in financing production. This will be possible through the legal creation of new forms of assurance directed at the poorest layers of our country, the approximately 160,000 souls of which i spoke earlier. I am referring to the mua security, the guarantee funds, the forced savings after obtaining the financing, the progressive mutualisation of the share capital and the solidarity guarantee. This framework will allow its regulation by a supervisory body, creating one of the conditions of success and sustainability of a microfinance system, in promoting development -access to the capital market and interbanking. The Bank of Cape Verde has been working on the creation of the legal framework for this purpose. My final message is reliable. I think the time is over when people thought that deep down, deep down, with more support here or there, we will solve our problems and the problem of poverty. I think it is time to take root in Cape Verdean society's awareness that we have a global problem of "knowing how to do it". And the awareness that we have this problem and that it will not be solved automatically is the best guarantee I have that we will know how to face it and solve it. What it takes, really, is to do and not ask. That's exactly what they're doing. So thank you all so much. 15-09-2010

Title: Speech at the AJOC Seminar - Association of Journalists of Cape Verde
text: Speech given by the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde at the AJOC Seminar -Association of Journalists of Cape Verde -Held on the beach, on 2.05.04 Good news is bad news  bad news sells more  this old journalistic maxim does not apply today and here, because the organization of this conference represents excellent news, thus radiating to AJOC signs of dynamism, and can contribute to the creation of a truly free press. I hope that they are incessant radiating, in line with what has been the histia of Cape Verdean journalism born long before independence, having conquered its genuinecapeverdean space, from which Eugenio de Paula Tavares stands out as one of its exponents in the first quarter of the twentieth century. I welcome these signs and that is exactly why I have accepted Dr Paul's invitation, which I thank you for. I also say that the new generation must assume its responsibilities, presenting results. Among economists, especially those in the financial area, and journalists there are infinite similarities. I just wanted to point out two: The first similarity is that we are all intermediaries. Economists and journalists are intermediaries, broadcast vehicles. While economists mediate between savings and investment, journalists mediate information. Both currency and information are scarce resources of strategic value that must be sought, mediated with capacity, daring, imagination, freedom and autonomy. The difference may exist, yes, in the margin of intermediation which for economists is generally greater than for journalists. Fortunately, economists say. And the second similarity has to do with trust. Economists work with credit, which originates from the word credere which means trust, an asset of extreme relevance to journalists, both in their relationship with sources and in their relationship with the consumer. The self-respecting journalist as well as a good financial person must first of all be a reliable transmission vehicle. And trust is achieved with the truth. In fact, journalism, said Heinrich Heine, a great German writer and journalist, is above all striving to tell the truth, the truth and the whole truth. The question that arises yesterday and today is how that might be possible. The openness to the whole, a concept defended by philofe Josef Pieper, in his essay on the role of the university  where he recalls that the spirit of an institution of this nature must be to gather all values, everything that surrounds man and not section reality, so that society, seeing itself, seek the changes that are necessary to promote the well-being of the entire population. This principle applies to journalism, something similar to what the arts and philosophy do. It is the language in the context of humanization of man, within the concept of philosophical anthropology, which qualifies man as a being who "forgets". Therefore, journalism must re/remember, spy, bring to memia everything that concerns man. It's a profession even. The image we have of the world and of our country was not the fruit, exclusively, of a direct experience, of observation with our eyes. Better, with our eyes and ears, through television, internet, newspapers, radio, among other media. Hence the responsibility of the journalist, especially in a world characterized today by an excess of information and that thanks to the satellite has become a village. There are studies that even establish very strong correlates between freedom of information, opinion and journalists, on the one hand, and poverty/wealth, on the other. All we have to do is see the contribution of democratic local power in our country to poverty reduction. The freer, the richer. It's as simple as that. I believe so, because I also believe in the virtualities of an open society and the role of journalists and free journalists in this society. Also for this, journalism is a power, some say fourth power. I don't like to hierarchize powers and say that journalism has important powers and is a catalyst force in an open society. This power grows every day. Fortunately! Precisely for this reason, the exercise of this power requires the practice of republican ethics, understood exclusively as scrupulous respect for the law, and responsibility. We refer to responsibility for truth, careful treatment of information, respect for sources and plico, care for private life and human rights and attention to religious and philosophical values. The press cannot be a force, by law, when it presents subtle but strong constraints to its full and normal development. I am talking above all about the specialised press and more specifically the specialised eco-products, which is the subject of my speech. It is therefore necessary to create, urgently, and implement a standard of operation for its relationship with specialized sources of information, because here seems to be one of the main blocks to the full functioning of the function-information, in particular when it is made from a professional process of journalistic research. If it is clear the importance of the source's contribution in the transmission of econic information, they, the sources, can distort the understanding of the facts. Because the source is driven by interests. Every source that provides information is making it available because it wants to achieve some purpose with that information. When the source is official, plica, part of the government, usually the sources want to benefit the governments they serve, and can contribute to disinformation. And the information can not serve to misinform. We must therefore de-nationalise and de-depart the media, preventing neither the state, nor the political parties, nor the financial interests from condition the functioning of the gons. These links can become a cancer for society that wants to be free, producing and reproducing self-censorship, the greatest evil of our media. For I argue that there is no plico journalism versus private journalism, but rather good and bad journalism and the dangers exist everywhere. No one turns into a good or bad journalist for the simple fact of working in a plico or private gon. With your permission I would like to refer to some news recently published by the newspapers, where from my point of view, I stress, the sources seem to have achieved their objectives, without the journalists having made a more careful analysis in order to be able to inform with objectivity. GDP growth at 7 pct in 2003; stock exchange; revolution of the financial system in the first week, development and investment bank, participation of Cape Verde in the WTO meeting; accumulation of functions of prime minister and minister of finance  the example of Luxembourg, the exchange of neros between the Governor and the Minister of Finance, Planning and Regional Development; competitiveness for the private sector, among others. Obviously the journalist has to investigate better and see what are the interests that move the sources, in order to be able to inform with the maximum possible exemption. That doesn't just depend on the journalist. It depends above all on the quality of journalism that we want to practice and on editorial policies, because often the room for manoeuvre of the individual journalist is very limited. Now, this seems possible through the construction of a triangle - tripod -virtuous, whose vertices are: 1: Professionalize and build trust by competence. The journalist must strive in such a way that he is seen by the company as a true expert, forcing himself to respect him and to take into account his opinions. Today, of the approximately 126 journalists, 66 are licensed, corresponding to 52 pct of the total, 35 have professional training (medium course, cenjor and vocational training, representing 34 pct of the total), which makes about 86% of professionals have training. It should be noted that 17 professionals, i.e. 14 pct of total, have incomplete courses, liceal education or technical school. These ratios show that the problem may lie in the editorial line and specialization, especially since there are more and more graduates in the ecological area who arrive in the country, implying an oversupply in this area. And if in fact there are no shortcomings in the supply of potential human resources for their possible long-term coverage, the problem will once again be reduced in the strategic option that the econica press take: sell canned food and fast food or do a way-based journalism, research and analysis? 2: bold and free journalists and full access to information. All journalists should be entitled to information by accessing administrative documents of a non-nominative nature, such as processes, reports, studies, opinions, minutes, documents, circulars, office-circulars, work orders, internal normative orders, instructions and guidelines for general interpretation or framework of activity or other information elements. Moreover, all services must be obliged to create the conditions for the full exercise of this right by journalists whose behavior must be guided by their statutes, supervised by the media council, possible if the said gao functions fully, being one of the guarantors of the proper functioning of the democratic rule of law, because it cannot exist without the freedom of the press. In this fight, The AJOC must be on the front line, because it is up to the State to guarantee, facilitate and promote free and full access to the documentation of the plica administration. With this standard to be respected, we do not guarantee free and full access to information, but we also fight in this way and preemptively against corruption and incompetence. But there is also the other side of the medal. There is a lot of information produced that is not properly used. I am referring to the information produced, in particular by bcv, INE, by companies in various areas and government and which could give rise to information and econic analyses of great use for the great plico. This information is underutilized. More, if there is trust, much more information can be made available. This is certainly one of the challenges to be overcome in the prime times. 3: autonomy of the journalist, avoiding the seduction of power. The state must legally protect journalists from abuse and also penalize excesses. Because ensuring free access to information and taking into account increased competition in the information market, the demands for the "responsible" journalist increase. Hence the urgent need for the proper management of the professional portfolio, respect for the statutes, translated into a cigo of conduct and ethics, prohibiting, inter alia, that the advantages or benefits - may even be preferential access to sources - may represent a limitation of the journalist's independence. The press must be independent, because this principle is one of the essential pillars of democracy and a matter of regime. However, it is necessary to avoid respect for ethical and moral principles from meaning a limitation to freedom of the press. The eco-journalist should stop looking for the news, exclusively, as a commodity. Journalists must first of all make information a raw material of strategic value. For this very good time, eco-journalism must play the role of promoting social welfare by creating and forming a democratic plica opinion. There is no democracy without plica opinion and no plica opinion without the media. It's as banal as this. And all those who look at the media as if it were a negio, can forget the debate about ethics. When we look at the ecological information, we find that often the news matter is treated as if it were fait divers. Or perhaps even with the tragic news, without a framing job. And not infrequently the concentration of business news in the eco-news of newspapers drives away eco-journalism of the role of welfare promoter. If it is imperative to make it clear that this has nothing ethically reprehensible or professionally derogatory, what we mean is that this option leaves open space for a new field of intervention of environmental information, based on independent and competent analytical capacity that transmits to the market an alternative vision to that provided to us by the companies concerned. The limitation of themes limits social debate, as reality is omitted. In Cape Verde and at the present time, the environmental information in general deals with business information, interviews of real business promotion, information whose source is the government or the plica administration. Precisely for this very part, the media must rethink its function and to that extent, tothat, also the traditional structure of the agenda, the traditional themes, the categories of content and the protagonism of civil society and opinion makers. For example, I do not understand to this day why the national radio of Cape Verde does not offer us an econico program? We have an echoic information that is evolving, but still very focused on personal approaches. Often, people are more important than institutions, making news perverse. You have to humanize the reaction. Give more space to workers, retirees, housewives, students, microentrepreneurs and plicos employees, addressing their living conditions, dreams, acts of the without roof, without school, without family, without going out, finally without citizenship. Examples, success stories at the level of companies, NGOs, individuals and institutions and plicas and private. Because the excluded do not dispm the same technical and institutional equipment as companies and political bodies  press office, fax, mail to flood the editorials of releases. The role of the eco-journalist should not be merely informative. The role of the eco-journalist should be to inform, analyze and show the reader that there are different ways of seeing the same theme or subject that is being dealt with there. Informing, explaining and analysing should be the permanent concerns of eco-journalists. There must be a clear differentiation between opinion and information, because the eco-facts must be considered for their causation and quantitative aspects and also for their sio-political implications. The environmental information is certainly less read, precisely, because in econic journalism there are still professionals who have not found a way to bring the news closer to the citizen's life without trivializing them. For example, when developing a matter on the balance of payments, the journalist often forgets that it has a sio-political implication in the reader's life. Those who, for example, understand that in the face of a balance of payments deficit, it is necessary to contain expenditure and therefore consumption, in principle positively values measures to contain wage growth, reduce credit to the economy and, where appropriate, increase taxes. Those who are not on the inside, value them in reverse. Control of the budget deficit can be more easily achieved if its implementation is monitored in a transparent manner. Today, the data made available monthly allow this control to be done by following bank financing, financing from the central bank and late payments, all monthly published data. And actually, that's what's going to make the reader interested in the story. In other words, eco-journalism must follow the basic rules of the press with regard to the reduction of any technical subject to the understanding of the ordinary citizen. It must clearly convey to the great plico the complex ecological analyses. The eco-journalist has to build this bridge. There is will and we are willing to support. The state and businesses must also do the same. Because the econic subject, at first glance, for most people is boring, but, in fact, it is quite interesting. It is necessary to taste the ecological information to be able to show this flavor to others. This is not an easy task. Even for economists, for there are many who can not write to the common plico. Most don't even master technical writing. It's not journalism technique, but even writing technique. In the view of many economists, and even some journalists, journalists in general are unprepared for econic coverage, meaning good econic journalism can be done by economists. That's certainly not true. Journalists counter that economists are unable to live in a full communication society. They cannot express themselves clearly and always use some obscure technical term to cover up this disability, blaming this communicative disability on the media and journalists. It must be everyone's fault and I advocate either the collaboration between journalists and economists in the same gon, a teamwork, or the expertise of journalists or economists. Academic background in a journalist's economics can help you in how he analyzes and criticizes information and sources. This will certainly allow him to conduct the interviews better because he knows what he's talking about. It's an asset. However, the fact that he does not have this training does not mean that the journalist is lost. Plus, having a specialization is a seal, a quality guarantee. Normally, the person who buys or subscribes to the variety newspaper does not go looking only for the econico newspaper. She is also looking for sport, wants to be informed about the economy  which comes in the form of a supplement  about politics, etc. In the background, it is covered the basic news that may be of interest to the reader. Regular monitoring of the securities market, budget implementation, monetary policy, tourism developments will not interest you. If someone wants or is in need of this information regularly they will have to find another alternative. There is no such alternative. Is there room for her? Can this space be created? I leave this issue to the debate. Our concern is thus summarized in a great observation: the better and better informed the readers, the more demands of excellence they make. Sque, too, are more of a shield and a safe one for increasingly independent information, which ultimately also benefits them. Good environmental information requires a demanding and qualified intervention from the journalist, the sources and the reader. And if the conditions are not created so that media players and journalists can respect the cigos of ethics and conduct, it must be urgently up to the political power to create these conditions, because it is a matter of regime. It seems to me that's our case when you look at our media gons. I would like to finish my speech, convinced that this debate is certainly not starting today, with five questions/needs, which are intertwined with everything we have said so far: 1. Professionalization and building trust by the competence and creation and urgent implementation of an operating standard for the relationship between the media gons and specialized sources of information; 2. Creation of state-held requirements for the exercise of free and full access to information and for the exercise of bold and responsible journalism, complying with and complying with laws; 3. Independence of journalists and editorial lines from the pleading stake, political and private, through scrupulous respect for ethics and conduct cigos. In this sense, it is urgent to intervene by the political powers in order to create material and legal conditions so that all media groups and journalists can respect them, ensuring their independence. There can be no free press if the gons are not. 4. Humanization of the world's notades. Give more space to workers, retirees, housewives, students, microentrepreneurs, and plicos employees, addressing their living conditions, dreams, acts of the roofless, without school, without family, without going out, in short, without citizenship. But also success stories at the level of companies, NGOs, individuals and public and private institutions. 5. Need to change the role of the eco-journalist that should not be merely informative. The role of the eco-journalist should be to inform, analyze and show the reader that there are different ways of seeing the same theme or subject that is being dealt with there. Informing, explaining and analysing should be the permanent concerns of eco-journalists. 6. Urgent use of a field still completely open to a new intervention of environmental information, based on independent and competent analytical capacity that transmits to the market an alternative vision to that provided to us by the companies concerned. 7. Creation of a fund managed by AJOC for the training of journalists in environmental matters, fuelled in particular by the State, companies, bilateral and international partners. I believe in transparency, in the dissemination of as much information as readily possible. That's not just a fair attitude. It, above all, makes markets more efficient in the long run. That's all for now. Stay vigilant. The democratic system so requires. Thank you!

Por isso, o jornalismo deve re/lembrar, espicaar, trazer  memia tudo o que diz respeito ao homem.  uma profisso inclusive. A imagem que temos do mundo e do nosso pas no foi fruto, exclusivamente, de uma experincia directa, da observao com os nossos prrios olhos. Melhor, com os nossos prrios olhos e ouvidos, atravs da televiso, internet, jornais, rdio, entre outros meios. Da a responsabilidade do jornalista, sobretudo num mundo caracterizado hoje por um excesso de informao e que graas ao satlite se transformou numa aldeia. H estudos que chegam a estabelecer correlas fortssimas entre a liberdade de informao, de opinio e dos jornalistas, por um lado, e a pobreza/riqueza, por outro. Basta vermos o contributo do poder local democrtico no nosso pas para a reduo da pobreza. Quanto mais livre, mais rico.  to simples quanto isto. Acredito que sim, porque acredito tambm nas virtualidades de uma sociedade aberta e no papel dos jornalistas e dos jornalistas livres nesta sociedade. Tambm por isso, o jornalismo  um poder, alguns dizem quarto poder. Eu que no gosto de hierarquizar poderes digo que o jornalismo tem poderes importantes e  uma fora catalizadora numa sociedade aberta. Esse poder cresce quotidianamente. Felizmente! Exactamente por isso, o exerccio deste poder exige a prtica da tica republicana, entendida exclusivamente como respeito escrupuloso pela lei, e responsabilidade . Referimo-nos  responsabilidade relativamente  verdade, tratamento cuidado das informas, respeito pelas fontes e plico, cuidado com a vida privada e os direitos humanos e ateno aos valores religiosos e filosicos. A imprensa no pode constituir-se, por direito prrio, numa fora, quando ela apresenta constrangimentos subtis mas fortssimos ao seu pleno e normal desenvolvimento. Falo sobretudo da imprensa especializada e mais concretamente da especializada em assuntos econicos, objecto desta minha interveno. , por isso, preciso criar, urgentemente, e implementar uma norma de funcionamento para o seu relacionamento com as fontes especializadas de informas, porque aqui parece estar um dos principais bloqueios ao pleno funcionamento da funo-informao, em particular quando  feita a partir de um processo profissional de investigao jornalstica. Se  evidente a importncia da contribuio da fonte na transmisso da informao econica, elas, as fontes, podem distorcer a compreenso dos factos. Porque a fonte  movida por interesses. Toda a fonte que fornece uma informao, est a disponibiliz-la porque quer atingir algum objectivo com essa informao. Quando a fonte  oficial, plica, parte do governo, normalmente as fontes querem beneficiar os governos a que servem, podendo contribuir para a desinformao. E a informao no pode servir para desinformar. Temos, por isso, que desestatizar e, despartidarizar a comunicao social, evitando que nem o estado, nem os partidos politicos, nem os interesses financeiros condicionem o funcionamento dos gos. Estes elos podem transformar-se num cancro para a sociedade que se quer livre, produzindo e reproduzindo a autocensura, o mal maior da nossa comunicao social. Pois defendo que no existe jornalismo plico versus jornalismo privado, mas sim bom e mau jornalismo e os perigos existem em todo o lado. Ningum se transforma num bom ou mau jornalista pelo simples facto de trabalhar num go plico ou privado . Com a vossa permisso queria fazer referncia a algumas noticias divulgadas recentemente pelos jornais, onde do meu ponto de vista, sublinho, as fontes parecem ter atingido os seus objectivos, sem que os jornalistas tivessem feito uma anlise mais cuidada por forma a poder informar com objectividade. Crescimento do PIB em 7 pct, em 2003; bolsa de valores; revoluo do sistema financeiro na prima semana, banco de desenvolvimento e de investimento, participao de Cabo-Verde na reunio da OMC; acumulao de funs de primeiro-ministro e de ministro das finanas  o exemplo de Luxemburgo, a troca de neros entre o Governador e o Ministro das Finanas, Planeamento e Desenvolvimento Regional; mais competitividade para o sector privado, entre outras. Obviamente que o jornalista tem de apurar melhor e ver quais so os interesses que movem as fontes, para poder informar com a mxima iseno possvel. Isso no depende apenas do jornalista. Depende sobretudo da qualidade do jornalismo que queremos praticar e das polticas editoriais, porque, muitas vezes, a margem de manobra do jornalista individual  deveras limitada. Ora, isto sparece possvel pela via da construo de um tringulo  trip -virtuoso, cujos vrtices so: 1: profissionalizar e construir a confiana pela competncia. O jornalista deve esforar-se de tal forma para que ele seja visto pela empresa como um verdadeiro especialista, obrigando-se a respeitlo e a levar em conta as suas opinis. Hoje, dos cerca de 126 jornalistas, 66 so licenciados, correspondendo a 52 pct do total, 35 tm formao profissional (curso mdio, cenjor e formao profissional, representando 34 pct do total), o que faz com que cerca de 86 % dos profissionais tenham formao. Importa registar que 17 profissionais, ou seja, 14 pct do total, tm cursos incompletos, ensino liceal ou escola tcnica. Estes rcios mostram que o problema spode residir na linha editorial e na especializao, tanto mais que h cada vez mais licenciados na rea econica que chegam ao pas, implicando um excesso de oferta nesta rea. E se na verdade no h insuficincias na oferta de potenciais meios humanos para a sua possvel cobertura a prazo, o problema vai reduzir-se uma vez mais na opo estratgica que a imprensa econica tomar: vender enlatados e fast food ou fazer um jornalismo  maneira, de investigao e anlise? 2: jornalistas ousados e livres e pleno acesso  informao. Todos os jornalistas devem ter direito  informao mediante o acesso a documentos administrativos de carcter no nominativo, designadamente processos, relatios, estudos, pareceres, actas, autos, circulares, oficio-circulares, ordens de servio, despachos normativos internos, instrus e orientas de interpretao geral ou de enquadramento de actividade ou outros elementos de informao. E mais: todos os servios devem ser obrigados a criar as condis para o exerccio pleno deste direito pelos jornalistas cujo comportamento deve ser balizado pelos seus estatutos, fiscalizado pelo conselho de comunicao social, spossvel se o referido go funcionar em pleno, sendo um dos garantes do bom funcionamento do estado de direito democrtico, pois ele no pode existir sem a liberdade de imprensa. Nesta luta, a AJOC deve estar na linha de frente, porque compete ao Estado garantir, facilitar e promover o acesso livre e total  documentao da administrao plica. Com esta norma a ser respeitada, no sgarantimos o livre e total acesso  informao como tambm combatemos por essa via e preventivamente contra a corrupo e a incompetncia. Mas h tambm o outro lado da medalha. H muita informao produzida que no  convenientemente utilizada. Refiro-me s informas produzidas, nomeadamente pelo BCV, INE, pelas empresas de diversas reas e Governo e que podiam dar origem a informas e anlises econicas de grande utilidade para o grande plico. Essas informas so sub-utilizadas. Mais, se houver confiana, pode-se disponibilizar muito mais informao. Este , certamente, um dos desafios a vencer nos primos tempos. 3: autonomia do jornalista, evitando a seduo do poder. O Estado deve proteger, legalmente, os jornalistas contra os abusos e penalizar tambm os excessos. Porque garantindo o livre acesso  informao e tendo em conta o aumento da concorrncia no mercado da informao, as exigncias relativamente ao jornalista responsvel aumentam. Da a necessidade urgente da boa gesto da carteira profissional, o respeito pelos estatutos, traduzidos num cigo de conduta e de tica, proibindo nomeadamente que as vantagens ou benesses -pode ser at o acesso preferencial s fontes -possam representar uma limitao da independncia do jornalista. A imprensa deve ser independente, pois este principio constitui um dos pilares essenciais da democracia e uma questo de regime. Contudo,  preciso evitar que o respeito pelos princpios ticos e morais signifique uma limitao  liberdade de imprensa. O jornalista econico deve deixar de procurar a noticia, exclusivamente, como uma mercadoria. Os jornalistas devem, antes de mais, fazer da informao uma matria prima de valor estratgico. Exactamente por isso, o jornalismo econico deve desempenhar o papel de promotor do bem-estar social, atravs da criao e formao de uma opinio plica democrtica. No existe democracia sem opinio plica e nem opinio plica sem os mdia.  to banal quanto isto. E todos aqueles que olham para os mdia como se de um negio se tratasse, podem esquecer o debate sobre a tica. Quando olhamos para a informao econica, constatamos que muitas vezes a matria noticiosa  tratada como se de fait divers se tratasse. Ou talvez mesmo com a actualidade trgica, sem um trabalho de enquadramento. E no raras vezes a concentrao de notcias empresariais no noticirio econico dos jornais afasta o jornalismo econico do papel de promotor de bem estar. Se  imperioso deixar claro que isto nada tem de eticamente reprovvel ou profissionalmente depreciativo, o que queremos dizer  que tal opo deixa espao aberto a um novo campo de interveno da informao econica, fundada na capacidade analtica independente e competente que transmita ao mercado uma viso alternativa  que nos  fornecida pelas empresas visadas. A limitao dos temas limita o debate social, na medida em que a realidade  omitida. Em Cabo Verde e no momento presente, as informas econicas na sua generalidade tratam a informao empresarial, as entrevistas de verdadeira promoo empresarial, as informas cuja fonte  o governo ou a administrao plica. Precisamente por isso, os mdia devem repensar a sua funo e nessa medida, tambm, a estrutura tradicional da agenda, as temticas tradicionais, as categorias de conteo e o protagonismo da sociedade civil e dos opinion makers. Por exemplo, no entendi at hoje porque  que a rdio nacional de Cabo Verde no nos oferece um programa econico? Temos uma informao econica que est a evoluir, mas ainda muito concentrada nos enfoques pessoais. Muitas vezes, as pessoas so mais importantes do que as instituis, tornando as noticias perversas.  preciso humanizar as redacs. Dar mais espao aos trabalhadores, aposentados, donas de casa, estudantes, microempresrios e funcionrios plicos, abordando as suas condis de vida, os sonhos, os actos dos sem tecto, sem escola, sem famlia, sem sae, enfim sem cidadania. Os exemplos, os casos de sucesso ao nvel das empresas, ONGs, indivduos e instituis plicas e privadas. Porque os excludos no dispm do mesmo aparato tcnico e institucional que as empresas e organismos polticos  assessoria de imprensa, fax, mail para inundar as editoriais de releases. O papel do jornalista econico no deve ser meramente informativo. O papel do jornalista econico deve ser o de informar, analisar e mostrar ao leitor que existem diferentes formas de ver o mesmo tema ou assunto que est sendo tratado ali. Informar, explicar e analisar devem constituir preocupas permanentes dos jornalistas econicos. Deve existir claramente uma diferenciao entre opinio e informao, pois os factos econicos devem ser considerados pelos seus aspectos causais e quantitativos e tambm pelas suas implicas sio-polticas. As informas econicas so certamente menos lidas, justamente, porque no jornalismo econico ainda h profissionais que no encontraram uma forma de aproximar o noticirio para perto da vida do cidado sem contudo banaliz-las. Por exemplo, ao desenvolver um assunto sobre a balana de pagamentos, muitas vezes o jornalista esquece que aquilo tem uma implicao sio-poltica na vida do leitor. Quem, por exemplo, compreender que perante um dficit da balana de pagamentos, h que conter a despesa plica e por isso o consumo, em principio valoriza positivamente as medidas de conteno do crescimento dos salrios, reduo do crdito  economia e, eventualmente, agravamento de impostos. Quem no estiver por dentro, valoriza-as de forma inversa. O controlo do dfice oramental pode ser mais facilmente atingido se a sua execuo for controlada de uma forma transparente. Hoje, os dados disponibilizados mensalmente permitem fazer esse controlo atravs do seguimento do financiamento bancrio, do financiamento junto do banco central e dos atrasados de pagamentos, todos dados mensalmente publicados. E, na verdade,  isso que vai fazer o leitor se interessar pela matria. Ou seja, o jornalismo econico deve seguir as regras bsicas da imprensa no que diz respeito  reduo de qualquer assunto tcnico  altura da compreenso do cidado comum. Ele deve transmitir de forma clara ao grande plico as complexas anlises econicas. O jornalista econico tem de construir esta ponte. Existe vontade e estamos dispostos a apoiar. O Estado e as empresas devem tambm fazer o mesmo. Porque o assunto econico,  primeira vista, para a maioria das pessoas  chato, mas, na verdade, ele  deveras interessante.  preciso saborear a informao econica para poder mostrar esse sabor aos outros. Esta no  uma tarefa fcil. Mesmo para os economistas, pois h muitos que no conseguem escrever para o plico comum. A maioria no domina mesmo a escrita tcnica. No  tcnica de jornalismo, mas tcnica de redaco mesmo. Na viso de muitos economistas, e at de alguns jornalistas, os jornalistas em geral so despreparados para a cobertura econica, ou seja um bom jornalismo econico spode ser feito por economistas. No  certamente verdade. Os jornalistas contrapm que os economistas so incapazes de viver numa sociedade de comunicao plena. Eles no conseguem expressar-se com clareza e utilizam sempre algum termo tcnico, obscuro para encobrir esta incapacidade, colocando a culpa dessa deficincia comunicativa nos mdia e nos jornalistas. A culpa deve ser de todos e defendo ou a colaborao entre jornalistas e economistas no mesmo go, um trabalho de equipa, ou a especializao dos jornalistas ou de economistas. A formao acadmica em economia de um jornalista pode ajud-lo na forma como ele analisa e critica as informas e as fontes. Isso vai-lhe permitir, certamente, conduzir melhor as entrevistas porque ele sabe do que est falando.  uma mais valia. Entretanto, o facto de no possuir esta formao no quer dizer que o jornalista se perde. Mais, ter uma especializao  um selo, uma garantia de qualidade. Normalmente, a pessoa que compra ou assina o jornal de variedades no vai  procura somente do jornal econico. Ela vai tambm  procura do desporto, quer estar informada sobre a economia  que vem sob a forma de suplemento -sobre a poltica, etc. No fundo,  coberto o noticirio bsico que possa ser do interesse do leitor. Um acompanhamento regular do mercado de ttulos de divida plica, da execuo oramental, da poltica monetria, da evoluo do turismo no o vai interessar. Se algum quiser ou estiver a precisar dessa informao regularmente ter que encontrar uma outra alternativa. Essa alternativa no existe. H espao para ela? Este espao pode ser criado? Deixo esta questo para o debate. A nossa preocupao sintetiza-se, assim, numa tima observao: quanto melhores e mais bem informados sejam os leitores, mais exigncias de excelncia fazem. Sque, tambm, mais se constituem no escudo e seguro para uma informao cada vez mais independente, o que, em ultima instncia, tambm os beneficia. Uma boa informao econica requer uma interveno exigente e qualificada do jornalista, das fontes e do leitor. E se as condis no estiverem criadas para que os gos de comunicao social e os jornalistas possam respeitar os cigos de tica e de conduta, deve caber urgentemente ao poder poltico criar essa condis, porque se trata de uma questo de regime. Parece-me que  o nosso caso, quando olhamos para os nossos gos de comunicao social. Gostaria de terminar a minha interveno, convencido de que este debate, certamente, no est a comear hoje, com cinco interrogas/necessidades, que entroncam com tudo aquilo que dissemos at agora: 1. Profissionalizao e construo da confiana pela competncia e criao e implementao urgente de uma norma de funcionamento para o relacionamento entre os gos de comunicao social e as fontes especializadas de informas; 2. Criao de condis por parte do Estado para o exerccio do livre e pleno acesso  informao e para o exerccio do jornalismo ousado e responsvel, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as leis; 3. Independncia dos jornalistas e das linhas editoriais face aos poderes plicos, polticos e privados, atravs do respeito escrupuloso dos cigos de tica e de conduta. Neste sentido, torna-se urgente a interveno dos poderes polticos no sentido da criao de condis materiais e legais para que todos os gos de comunicao social e os jornalistas possam respeit-los, garantindo a independncia dos mesmos. No pode haver imprensa livre se os gos no o so. 4. Humanizao das redacs. Dar mais espao aos trabalhadores, aposentados, donas de casa, estudantes, microempresrios, e funcionrios plicos, abordando as suas condis de vida, os sonhos, os actos dos sem tecto, sem escola, sem famlia, sem sae, enfim, sem cidadania. Mas tambm os casos de sucesso ao nvel das empresas, ONGs, indivduos e instituis publicas e privadas. 5. Necessidade de mudana do papel do jornalista econico que no deve ser meramente informativo. O papel do jornalista econico deve ser o de informar, analisar e mostrar ao leitor que existem diferentes formas de ver o mesmo tema ou assunto que est sendo tratado ali. Informar, explicar e analisar devem constituir preocupas permanentes dos jornalistas econicos. 6. Aproveitamento urgente de um campo ainda completamente aberto a uma nova interveno da informao econica, fundada na capacidade analtica independente e competente que transmita ao mercado uma viso alternativa  que nos  fornecida pelas empresas visadas. 7. Criao de um fundo gerido pela AJOC para a formao de jornalistas em matria econica, alimentado nomeadamente pelo Estado, empresas, parceiros bilaterais e internacionais. Acredito na transparncia, na disseminao do mximo de informas o mais prontamente possvel. Essa no  uma atitude apenas justa. Ela, acima de tudo torna os mercados mais eficientes a longo prazo.  tudo por agora. Mantenham-se vigilantes. O sistema democrtico assim o exige. Obrigado!

text: Untitled Document Page 1 of 2 Speech given by the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde at the time of the book's launch "Subsidies for the Understanding of Cape Verde and Guinea Histia" by Jose de Senna Barcelos My first words are of sincere and deep thanks to all those who have sprouted sweat so that this second edition of this historical monument is a reality today, more than a hundred years since the first edition. For this treat and for the competence and dedication placed at the service of this edition, my thanks to the National Library Institute in the people of Dr. Auzenda Silva, who started this journey, and Dr. Joaquim Morais who is continuing. That's right, a courier race. Recognition to Dr. Daniel Pereira for the beautiful notes introdutias. In fact, they are not notes from the Central Bank, but an act of histia and, therefore, culture, also because the important requirement that he made at the time was to have time available for these notes to be quality. I was astonious and remembered Napoleon Bonaparte, the famous French soldier, who said that "the surest way to stay poor is to be honest." I am immensely grateful to Dr. Tome Varela, re-writer of various tests, rigorous and tireless. To Dr. Tita Rocha, Dr. Luis Filipe, Dr. Humberto and Mr. Antio Ramos a very deep thank you for the mastery, finesse and affection as they treated this monument. The company "Virar da Pagina" also deserves our praise for the quality of the work developed. To all those involved, our many thanks, for I have witnessed your permanent and intense dedication. These days, in this globalized world of fierce competition, you have a future for those who have passed and know how to value it. E. Lourenco said that " losing the memia of the past is for the present to fail the future." However, our past and, consequently, our future were marginalized, until the end of the 19th century, in the studies and attention scans of Portuguese overseas historiography. India, Brazil or even Japan have completely overshadowed these sleeping islands in the middle Atlantic. And it was precisely in 1899 that a first work of such importance appeared on the histia of these islands, an exhaustive memia, composed of 6 parts, which covered the entire history of Cape Verde, assigning it an unpretentious title -"Subsidies".
