Title: Communication on the occasion of the Atelier on the New Paradigm of Public Debt Management
text: The stability of the Financial System and Supervision Communication of the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde, on the occasion of the Atelier on The New Paradigm of Pblica Debt Management With the reform carried out in the early 1990s, in 1993, the bcv functions were separated as a central and commercial bank, and began to assume exclusively the function of central bank. This phase is also marked by the objective of amending the mechanisms for the functioning of monetary policy, based mainly on direct instruments, in particular the credit card. With the reform, the internal financing of the budget deficit and cash requirements is now made using the issuance of plica debt securities, a function assigned to the Bank of Cape Verde, pursuant to the Organic Law, approved on 16 July of that year, and the allocation of debt management to the BCV did not present additional charges for the State. According to Decree-Law No. 59/2009 and 60/2009, in the current context of globalization and the new planning of the international financial system, state financing must be structured in ways that induce greater efficiency in the contracting of public credit, on the assumption of total flexibility between uniform modalities and discrimination, depending on the specific market conditions prevailing in each placement. The platform associated with the management of the plica debt aims to respond to the restructuring needs of the capital market of Cape Verde, seeking to bring the Treasury closer to investors, based on the offer of new services, through modern and accessible access channels and that ensure security in the placement of data via the Internet. The aim is to: Extend the number of participants in the primary market and enhance long-term savings mechanisms as well as their liquidity in the secondary market. Improve the management of emisss and create mechanisms that allow effective control/monitoring of the Treasury, before, after and after the emisss. Boosting the secondary debt market plica Lower ing the cost of state funding Given the unavoidable and growing opening up of cape Verde's economy and its anticipated greater dependence on an international financial system dominated by market mechanisms, it is essential that the domestic financial sector also increasingly adjusts to market mechanisms. One of the great benefits of a developed debt market, in particular of plicabonds, is that it makes it possible to make long-term financing and investment needs compatible. A mature bond market provides a range of opportunities to fund the government and the private sector, with the bond market pleading to boost the process and creating opportunities for other issuers. The plico bond market typically functions as the backbone of most fixed income bond markets, both in developed and developing markets. The development of the internal market for plica debt is fundamental in the development of the financial sector. The development of the plica debt market is considered essential for a country to enter a sustained phase of development supported by a market-based capital allocation process. In addition, the central role played by the debt market in strengthening the resilience of a country's financial system and protecting it against external shocks, contagion and reducing access to the international financial market is recognised. At macro-econic policy level it provides a financing window for budget deficits, different from that provided by central banks, thus reducing or cancelling the need for deficit monetisation and avoiding the accumulation of debt denominated in foreign currency. The development of the plica debt market can also strengthen monetary policy transmission mechanisms and enhance the use of indirect monetary policy instruments. It also enables authorities to smooth investment and consumer costs in response to shocks. It contributes to the reduction of costs associated with debt service in the medium and long term by developing the depth and liquidity of the securities bond market. In the case of Cape Verde, the role of plico financing is strengthened, given the significant weight of internal plica debt in the financial system. One of the major challenges long identified is the creation of a secondary treasury market with an active participation of financial intermediaries, as an essential condition for the success of any state financing programme, based on market mechanisms. In this context it is necessary that the securities are negotiable with great fluidity. This involves minimising restrictions on their negotiation, including taxation on the transactions. Market efficiency and, consequently, greater liquidity given to securities is essential in this process. It is also recognised that the greater the amount of securities held by the non-monetary sector, the faster and more effective the transmission of monetary policy to the real economy will be. Indeed, monetary institutions often need to acquire securities from the non-monetary sector, thereby promoting more efficient pricing at the time of central bank financing. In this perspective, the coordination of monetary and budgetary policies, which is already an institutionalised but which is to be improved, between the MF and the BCV, is of increased importance in the new context, bearing in view of the importance of increasing capacity to mobilise internal funding and develop new financing mechanisms. At microeconic level, the development of a domestic securities market can increase overall financial stability and improve financial intermediation through increased competition in financial intermediation. It enables the emergence of an income curve that contributes to better risk management and financial stability. In view of the above we have auded successes to the government with this initiative. Beach, April 1, 2013
text_original: A estabilidade do Sistema Financeiro e a Superviso Comunicao do Governador do Banco de Cabo Verde, por ocasio do Atelier sobre O Novo Paradigma de Gesto da Dvida Pblica Com a reforma levada a cabo no incio da dcada de noventa, procedeu-se em 1993,  separao das funs do BCV, enquanto banco central e comercial, passando a assumir exclusivamente a funo de banco central. Esta fase  tambm marcada pelo objectivo de alterao dos mecanismos de funcionamento da poltica monetria, baseados sobretudo em instrumentos directos, nomeadamente o plafond de crdito. Com a reforma, o financiamento interno do dfice oramental e das necessidades de tesouraria passa a ser feito com recurso  emisso de ttulos de dvida plica, funo atribuda ao Banco de Cabo Verde, nos termos da Lei Orgnica, aprovada em 16 de Julho do referido ano, sendo que a atribuio da gesto da dvida plica ao BCV no apresentava encargos adicionais para o Estado. De acordo com os Decretos-Lei n 59/2009 e 60/2009, no actual contexto de globalizao e do novo ordenamento do sistema financeiro internacional, o financiamento do Estado deve passar pela estruturao de leils em moldes que induzam a uma maior eficincia na contratao do crdito pblico, num pressuposto de total flexibilidade entre modalidades uniformes e discriminatrias, em funo das condis especficas de mercado prevalecentes em cada colocao. A plataforma associada  gesto da dvida plica pretende responder s necessidades de reestruturao do mercado de capitais de Cabo Verde, procurando aproximar o Tesouro dos investidores, com base na oferta de novos servios, atravs de canais de acesso modernos e acessveis e que garantem a segurana na colocao dos dados via internet. Com efeito, pretende-se:  Alargar o nmero de participantes no mercado primrio e potenciar mecanismos de poupana de longo prazo, bem como a sua respectiva liquidez no mercado secundrio.  Melhorar a gesto das emisss e criar mecanismos que permitem um controlo/acompanhamento efectivo do Tesouro, antes, depois e ap as emisss.  Dinamizar o mercado secundrio de dvida plica  Decrescer o custo de financiamento do Estado Face  abertura incontornvel e crescente da economia de Cabo Verde e a sua antecipada maior dependncia dum sistema financeiro internacional dominado pelos mecanismos de mercado,  fundamental que o sector financeiro domstico tambm se ajuste crescentemente aos mecanismos de mercado. Um dos grandes benefcios dum mercado da dvida desenvolvido, em particular de obrigaes plicas,  que permite compatibilizar as necessidades de financiamento e de investimento de longo prazo dos agentes. Um mercado de obrigas maduro propicia uma gama de oportunidades para financiar o governo e o sector privado, com o mercado obrigacionista plico a dinamizar o processo e criando oportunidades para outros emitentes. O mercado de obrigas plico normalmente funciona como a coluna vertebral da maior parte dos mercados de ttulos de renda fixa, quer nos mercados desenvolvidos como em desenvolvimento. O desenvolvimento do mercado interno da dvida plica  fundamental no desenvolvimento do sector financeiro. Considera-se que o desenvolvimento do mercado da dvida plica  essencial para que um pas possa entrar numa fase sustentada de desenvolvimento suportada por um processo de afectao de capital com base no mercado. Para alm disso, reconhece-se o papel central ocupado pelo mercado da dvida plica no reforo da resilincia do sistema financeiro de um pas e na sua proteco contra choques externos, ao contgio e  reduo do acesso ao mercado financeiro internacional. A nvel da poltica macroeconica fornece uma janela de financiamento para os dfices oramentais, diferente da proporcionada pelos bancos centrais, permitindo por conseguinte reduzir ou anular a necessidade de monetizao do dfice e evitar a acumulao de dvida denominada em moeda estrangeira. O desenvolvimento do mercado da dvida plica pode tambm reforar os mecanismos de transmisso da poltica monetria e potencia a utilizao de instrumentos indirectos de poltica monetria. Possibilita ainda s autoridades alisar as despesas de investimento e de consumo em resposta a choques. Contribui para a reduo dos custos associados ao servio da dvida no mdio e longo prazo pela via do desenvolvimento da profundidade e liquidez do mercado das obrigas plicas. No caso de Cabo Verde, o papel do financiamento plico sai reforado, face ao peso significativo da dvida plica interna no sistema financeiro. Um dos grandes desafios h muito identificado, prende-se com a criao de um mercado secundrio de ttulos do Tesouro com uma participao activa dos intermedirios financeiros, enquanto condio essencial para o sucesso de qualquer programa de financiamento do Estado, com base em mecanismos de mercado. Nesse mbito  necessrio que os ttulos sejam negociveis com grande fluidez. Tal passa pela minimizao das restris  sua negociao, incluindo a fiscalidade que incide sobre as transacs. A eficincia do mercado e, por consequncia, a maior liquidez conferida aos ttulos  fundamental nesse processo. Reconhece-se tambm que quanto maior for a quantidade de ttulos na posse do sector no monetrio, mais rpida e eficaz ser a transmisso da poltica monetria  economia real. Com efeito, muitas das vezes as instituis monetrias para obterem moeda central necessitam de adquirir ttulos ao sector no monetrio, promovendo por conseguinte uma formao de preos mais eficiente,  data do financiamento do Banco Central. Nesta perspectiva, a coordenao das polticas monetria e oramental, que j constitui uma prtica institucionalizada, mas que se quer melhorada, entre o MF e o BCV, assume uma importncia acrescida no novo contexto, tendo em conta que nesta fase de transio do pas, reveste-se de extrema importncia uma maior capacidade de mobilizao do financiamento interno e o desenvolvimento de novos mecanismos de financiamento. A nvel microeconico, o desenvolvimento dum mercado domstico de ttulos pode aumentar a estabilidade financeira global e melhorar a intermediao financeira atravs nomeadamente de maior concorrncia na intermediao financeira. Possibilita a emergncia duma curva de rendimento que contribui para a melhor gesto do risco e para a estabilidade financeira. Face ao acima exposto auguramos sucessos ao governo com esta iniciativa. Praia, 1 de Abril de 2013

Title: Speech at the Seminar issuing Securities and Public Offerings in times of crisis
text: Speech by the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde, Carlos Burgo, at the Seminar issuing Securities and Plicas Offers in times of crisis, June 3, 2013 Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Cape Verde lives a histia somewhat similar to those of Portugal and Ireland but fortunately much less dramatic. Despite the crisis, in the last four years, the country has successfully managed to achieve emisses, mostly bondholders and long-term, with the volume of resources mobilized to grow on average almost 8% per year, which indicates, in a way, that domestic institutional investors positively evaluate national options in the field of management of phasing finances. It should also be noted that, unlike the countries mentioned, Cape Verde is able to mobilise resources to meet its financing needs without having to be subject to adjustment programmes imposed by the international community. However, despite this relativerecent and prospective success, we cannot be satisfied. There are mtiplos challenges to be addressed and Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 4 to win. It is not enough for the State to be able to finance itself so that it can be considered that the financial system is properly fulfilling its function. The private sector must also be able to do so, thus enabling private operators to have the resources to finance their investment projects and thus contribute to economic growth and employment. And in this context, as has been the case in the banking sector, in 2011 and 2012 we face important challenges in the securities market. In the period between 2005 and 2010 the national market registered an average of almost four plicas offers per year, with an average fitting per issue of 870,000 contos. It should also be noted that about two thirds of these emisss were made by private companies. In contrast to this dynamic, in 2011 there was no ica plica offer and in 2012 there were only two, with a restructuring operation carried out by a plica company with treasury guarantee and another an issue made by a plica company with a letter of comfort from the State. text_original: Discurso do Governador do Banco de Cabo Verde, Carlos Burgo, no Seminrio Emisso de Valores Mobilirios e Ofertas Plicas em tempos de crise, 3 de Junho de 2013 Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 1 Ilustres Conferencistas e Convidados, Minhas Senhoras e Meus Senhores, Em nome do Banco de Cabo Verde e da Auditoria Geral do Mercado de Valores Mobilirios, apraz-me registar e agradecer a vossa presena nesta Conferncia Internacional e dar as boas vindas aos ilustres conferencistas e aos convidados que responderam favoravelmente ao nosso convite. A vossa presena aqui hoje para discutir o tema proposto  prova, positiva creio eu, de que o mercado de valores mobilirios continua a suscitar um bom nvel de interesse junto dos seus mtiplos stakeholders, espero que apesar da crise e no por causa da crise. Com este evento esperam o Banco de Cabo Verde e a Auditoria Geral do Mercado de Valores Mobilirios corresponder s vossas expectativas de disponibilizao de uma plataforma de reflexo e dilogo com vista  consolidao de um mercado que todos almejmos, merecemos e temos obrigao de juntos construir, consolidar e desenvolver. Estamos em crer que um evento para debater a problemtica da emisso de valores mobilirios no podia acontecer em melhor momento. H pouco menos de um ano, no dia 5 de Julho de 2012, o jornal britnico The Guardian noticiava com entusiasmo o regresso da Irlanda aos mercados: atravs de um leilo de 500 milhs de euros, o Estado irlands conseguiu nesse dia colocar Bilhetes do Tesouro a trs meses. Numa situao normal, antes da crise financeira, uma operao do tipo passaria despercebida. Porm, nesta ocasio, foi considerado algo de extraordinrio. Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 2 O Ministro irlands das Finanas classificou a colocao como  um marco importante no caminho da recuperao para a Irlanda. J o Presidente do Banco Central Europeu falou em   sucesso que merece ser celebrado. Um pouco por todo o lado, o regresso aos mercados passou a ser tema importante de conversa. Emisso, bem sucedida, em tempo de crise, na formulao do tema da nossa conferncia de hoje. E o entusiasmo dos irlandeses foi partilhado um pouco por toda a Europa, e tambm pelo resto do mundo. Afinal, para um pas marginalizado pelos mercados internacionais durante quase dois anos, qualquer emisso de dvida plica bem sucedida, ainda que de pequeno montante e a curto prazo, merece ser festejada. Num comentrio  notcia atrs referida, um bloguista comparava a euforia irlandesa ao caso de um atleta profissional que sofreu uma grave leso e, ap dois anos de mtiplas intervens cirgicas e intensa fisioterapia, ensaia os primeiros passos apoiado em canadianas e sonha um dia regressar  alta competio. Voltando aos mercados, regressar  alta competio significa realizar emisss obrigacionistas com sucesso, indicao clara de que os mercados confiam nos fundamentais do emitente em causa, pelo que est disponvel para lhe facultar recursos, a um custo acessvel, para que possa caminhar sozinho, sem a ajuda da comunidade internacional. Numa realidade que nos  mais prima, Portugal, este regresso aconteceu h menos de um ms, quando o Tesouro portugus, finalmente, conseguiu colocar uma emisso obrigacionista de 3,92 mil milhs de euros, a sua primeira emisso a 10-anos desde que Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 3 solicitou e obteve um resgate internacional. Com esta emisso, Portugal chegou ao fim de um perodo de dois anos de costas viradas para os mercados internacionais, pois estes exigiam taxas proibitivas para compensar os riscos inerentes  sua dvida soberana. Cabo Verde vive uma histia de certo modo parecida com as de Portugal e da Irlanda mas, felizmente, muito menos dramtica. Apesar da crise, nos timos quatro anos, o pas tem conseguido realizar com sucesso emisses, na sua maioria obrigacionistas e de longo prazo, com o volume de recursos mobilizado a crescer em mdia quase 8% ao ano, o que indica, de certo modo, que os investidores institucionais domsticos avaliam positivamente as ops nacionais em matria de gesto das finanas plicas. Numa outra nota muito positiva, no passado dia 28 de Maio, investidores particulares nacionais puderam aceder directamente, pela primeira vez, ao mercado primrio para adquirir ttulos de dvida plica. At o final do corrente ano, espera o Tesouro mobilizar mais 3.5 milhs de contos atravs de ofertas plicas dirigidas tanto a investidores institucionais como particulares. Esperamos e contamos que esse plano se materialize, permitindo assim que o Estado resolva as suas necessidades de financiamento para poder cumprir com as suas responsabilidades para com a economia. Importa ainda referir que, ao contrrio dos pases referidos, Cabo Verde vai conseguindo mobilizar recursos para suprir as suas necessidades de financiamento sem ter de se sujeitar a programas de ajustamento impostos pela comunidade internacional. Porm, apesar deste relativo sucesso recente e prospectivo, no nos podemos dar por satisfeitos. Existem desafios mtiplos a enfrentar e Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 4 a vencer. No basta que o Estado consiga se financiar para que se possa considerar que o sistema financeiro esteja a cumprir adequadamente a sua funo.  preciso que o sector privado o possa tambm fazer, permitindo assim aos operadores privados disporem de recursos para financiar os seus projectos de investimento e assim contriburem para o crescimento econico e para o emprego. E nesse mbito,  semelhana do que vem acontecendo no sector bancrio, em 2011 e 2012 enfrentamos importantes desafios no mercado de valores mobilirios. No perodo entre 2005 e 2010 o mercado nacional registou uma mdia de quase quatro ofertas plicas por ano, com um encaixe mdio por emisso da ordem de 870 mil contos. Esta evoluo menos favorvel registada nos timos dois anos diznos inequivocamente que temos importantes obstculos a transpor para que o mercado de valores mobilirios nacional possa consolidar e reforar o seu papel no financiamento da economia e enquanto mobilizador e colocador da poupana. Por ora, permitam-me apenas partilhar convosco algumas iniciativas relevantes recentemente levadas a cabo pelo Banco de Cabo Verde ou em curso:  Melhoria da regulao, atravs da reviso e modernizao das normas aplicveis  actividade seguradora, ao mercado de valores mobilirios e  actividade bancria e no bancria;  Reforo da superviso pela via da melhoria dos regulamentos, da capacitao, e do reforo em recursos humanos e tcnicos;  Melhoria do acompanhamento dos principais sectores de actividade econica, e da aco em matria de poltica monetria, disseminando conhecimentos e promovendo comportamentos mais consentneos com as oportunidades de crescimento disponveis;  Acompanhamento e apoio ao processo de desenvolvimento dos sistemas de pagamento. Num pas pequeno, insular e arquipelgico como Cabo Verde, a garantia de um clima adequado de investimento coloca exigncias acrescidas ao Estado, designadamente no que respeita  disponibilidade de infra-estruturas econicas que permitam garantir servios com qualidade e a preo competitivos. Para tal o Estado tem necessariamente de investir recursos considerveis. E para investir tem de, pelo menos em parte, recorrer ao endividamento junto do sistema financeiro interno. Title: Intervention on the occasion of the opening session of the III Accounting Meeting of the Central Banks of portuguese-speaking countries, Praia
text: Speech by Administrator Manuel Pinto Frederico, on the occasion of the opening session of the III Accounting Meeting of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries Beach, June 24, 2013 III ACCOUNTING MEETING OF CENTRAL BANKS OF PORTUGUESE-SPEAKING COUNTRIES PRAIA, 24 and 25 JUNE 2013 Mr. Deputy Governor of the National Bank of Angola, Exmos. Ladies and gentlemen Directors and responsible for Accounting and Financial Control of the Central Banks of Angola, Brazil, Cape Verde, Guinea-Bissau, Mozambique, Portugal, S. Tome and Principe and East Timor, Exma. Ms. Director of Audit and Supervision of the Bank of Cape Verde, Expensive participants, Ladies and gentlemen, On behalf of the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde and in my own name, I would like to welcome you to Cape Verde and wish you all a good stay among us. For the reason of agenda - a mission abroad - Mr. Governor could not be present at this opening session. It is with great satisfaction that banco de Cabo Verde hosts this year the III Accounting Meeting of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries, after the first two editions that were hosted by the National Bank of Angola and the Central Bank of Brazil, respectively, in 2011 and 2012. Last May the BCV organized, on The Salt Island, the Forum of Technologies and Information Systems of the Central Banks of portuguese-speaking countries which, in passing, was very productive, and it is with great honor and pleasure that we are today receiving our partners of the BC of the CPLP for this new action in the framework of multilateral cooperation between our Banks. With the main objective of the discussion and sharing of information between our institutions, this III Meeting will be an excellent opportunity to address not only specific topics in the area of Accounting and Financial Control, but also others of interest to the activity of the Central Banks, of which we highlight: (i) the classification of the financial instruments that make up the reserves of central banks; (ii) the balance sheet risks of a central bank; (iii) international harmonisation; (iv) pension funds, and (v) 'Senhoriage'. It is our firm wish that during the two days of work we can stimulate discussion and reflection on these very current issues, providing accounting officers, as well as those in other areas of central banks, including supervisory, audit ing and markets, with a range of opportunities for recycling and improvement, in particular, for the sharing of knowledge and experience between our institutions. These are indeed issues of high importance for our banks and which meet the need for increasing transparency and accountability in the activity of central banks. In fact, as Kenneth Sullivam (senior imf monetary and foreign exchange expert) said, "the transparent financial statements of a Central Bank make it easier for bank supervisors to require a similar level of disclosure for the commercial banks they oversee." Therefore, we are living today a new reality, with significant changes in the way of registration and production of reports, from the reception in our accounting systems, of ifrs (International Financial Reporting Standards). Moreover, converging in Accounting means adhering to internationally accepted standards, such as IFRS. These changes take Accounting to a new level, where well-trained professionals with good analytical capacity and systemic vision will be needed, allowing a better understanding of the Central Bank's operations by entities to whom it reports and also resulting in greater external credibility of the institution. Before i finish, I would like to hope that at the end of the work it is possible to ensure the maintenance of a solid conceptual structure for accounting, greater convergence towards the comparability of the financial statements between our Central Banks and, above all, a better preparation for our accounting reports to be transparent and credible. Finally, I wish you all a good job and Ask you to feel at home. I declare the 3rd Accounting Meeting of the Central Banks of portuguese-speaking countries open. Beach, June 24, 2013

Tendo como objectivo principal a discusso e partilha de informao entre as nossas instituies, este III Encontro ser uma excelente oportunidade para abordagem no s de temas especficos da rea da Contabilidade e Controlo Financeiro, mas tambm de outros de interesse para a actividade dos Bancos Centrais, dos quais destacamos: i) A classificao dos instrumentos financeiros que compem as reservas dos Bancos Centrais; ii) Os riscos de balano de um banco central; iii) A harmonizao internacional; iv) Os fundos de penses, e v) Senhoriagem.  nosso firme desejo que durante os dois dias de trabalhos se possa estimular a discusso e a reflexo sobre esses temas muito actuais, proporcionando aos responsveis da Contabilidade, bem como aos de outras reas dos Bancos Centrais, nomeadamente aos da Superviso, da Auditoria e dos Mercados, uma gama de oportunidades para a reciclagem e o aprimoramento, em especial, para a partilha de conhecimentos e experincias entre as nossas instituies. Trata-se, efectivamente, de temas de elevada importncia para os nossos Bancos e que vo de encontro  necessidade de uma cada vez maior transparncia e accountability na actividade dos Bancos Centrais. Alis, como dizia Kenneth Sullivam (expert snior do Sector Monetrio e Cambial do FMI) as demonstraes financeiras transparentes de um Banco Central tornam mais fcil para os supervisores bancrios exigir um nvel similar de reporte (disclosure) para os bancos comerciais que eles supervisionam. Portanto, estamos a viver hoje uma nova realidade, com mudanas significativas na forma de registo e produo de reportes, a partir do acolhimento nos nossos ordenamentos contabilsticos, das IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards). Para finalizar, desejo a todos um bom trabalho e peo que se sintam em casa. Declaro aberto o III Encontro de Contabilidade dos Bancos Centrais dos Pases de Lngua Portuguesa. Title: Governor's Speech in the Act of Commemoration of the 3rd Anniversary BES
text: Speech by Governor Carlos Burgo in the Act of Commemoration of the 3rd Anniversary of BES-Cape Verde Beach, July 8, 2013 Exma Bes-CV Administration Ladies and gentlemen Let my first words be addressed to the BES-CV Administration, whom I congratulate on the passage of the 3rd anniversary of the Bank's installation in Cape Verde, recognising the important contribution it has made to the economic sector in Cape Verde, in particular through the provision of services to non-residents. The entry of BES-CV into Cape Verde was undoubtedly an encouraging and reliable sign in the Cape Verdean financial sector, which will have become stronger, and an opportunity to exploit the potential of the Lusophone markets and the African sub-region where Cape Verde is located. I am very honoured to be able to speak at this ceremony (I therefore take this opportunity to thank the invitation that has been made to me) and to have the opportunity to present some reflections on the economic and financial perspectives of a country facing enormous challenges, which require structural changes in its economy, in the face of an international situation characterized by enormous complexity and high risks for the stability of the international economic and financial system. I would therefore like to recall that, in addition to the Bank of Cape Verde's main mission - the maintenance of price stability - another of its fundamental tasks is to safeguard the stability of the financial system, and is currently focused on strengthening regulation and supervision and promoting sound management practices, which include improving the capacity for analysis and risk management, should be minimised, as well as preserving confidence in the system. My intervention in these commemorations also gives me the opportunity to highlight the relevance of banking activity in financing the economy, which justifies the strengthening of legal and normative instruments, which are in the process of being approved, in response to the challenges of the current international and national situation. My Lords and My Lords, One of the main lessons that can be learned from the already protracted international economic and financial crisis is the importance of taking prudent management, inserted in a strategy of constant anticipation and risk minimisation. This is because, in the case of their materialisation, the authorities are often confronted with unknown territories, so corrective measures tend to prove to be much more complex in their design and implementation, with very unfavourable impacts on social welfare. At the Bank of Cape Verde, a central concern has been to identify, in advance, the main risks to the country's economy and the financial system in particular. A key aspect, in particular because of its cross-cutting/global impact on all institutional sectors, from the point of view of national accounting, is the dynamics of economic activity and its social implications, with emphasis on employment. The available data point to a significant slowdown in economic activity: such developments put the question of the growth potential of the economy at the heart of priorities. What will be the most credible reference value for the growth potential of the economy? What are the current and future potential sources of growth in the Cape Verdean economy? What and how to take appropriate measures to improve this potential? Directly linked to this problem is the need to improve economic competitiveness, the business environment, professional qualification, labour legislation and, in general, the reduction of risks to economic activity, particularly in relation to the private sector. Risk mitigation management in the economy is therefore key. In an assessment of the main risks to the economy, these are, in my view, in the medium and long term, which means that we are still in a position to strengthen and/or take the necessary measures to increase the resilience of the country's economy, in particular to cope with the emergence of adverse external shocks. This presupposes, among others, the existence of a macroeconomic area  at budgetary and monetary level. A minimally adequate level of foreign exchange reserves and non-excessive state indebtedness are two essential conditions to be respected, under the economic regime in force in the country, where credibility and trust are fundamental. A context of weak economic growth implies less dynamism on the tax revenue side for the State, imposing a need for adjustment on the expenditure side. But companies themselves and households have to make adjustments to prevent their indebtedness and the country's level of indebtedness from reaching an excessive level. As regards the banking system specifically, it should be noted that, in general, existing liquidity and profitability levels allow banks to cope with many of the possible emerging risks, despite the fact that in 2012 banks faced a difficult situation as a corollary of the impact of the external framework on economic activity. Despite the growth in assets, the results and profitability of the banking sector continued the previous downward trend. Banking activity in 2012 increased, with total net assets growing by 11.14%, reflecting the higher volume of investments in credit institutions at home and abroad. Deposits remain the main source of financing, representing 71% of the resources, confirming the recognised stability of banks' funding and a comfortable liquidity situation. The profitability of equity and assets showed some reduction, pointing to a less favourable performance in resource management, proven by the significant reduction in bank efficiency (cost-to-income ratio) and by the decrease in financial margin. As regards the adequacy of own funds, the strengthening of provisions in view of the deterioration in the quality of the credit portfolio resulted in a significant reduction in the system's own funds, which, accompanied by a slight increase in assets at risk, led to a reduction in ratios. Although the solvency ratio of the system (12.13%) is above the regulatory minimum (10%), this seemingly comfortable situation does not exclude banks from prudent management that safeguards the solvency and stability of the system. In terms of risks, credit remains the main constraint for the system, mainly due to the concentration in the housing and construction sectors and a small number of counterparties. There was an unfavorable evolution in the quality of the credit portfolio, with the increase in the level of overall default, accompanied, however, by the strengthening of provisions, following the recommendation of the BCV. In relation to liquidity risk, the transformation ratio decreased in 2012 as a result of the significant increase in deposits. This has resulted in an improvement in the overall liquidity framework of the system, with a trend towards restructuring the composition of assets in order to favour those with greater liquidity. It can therefore be said that the national financial system, and particularly the banking sector, is struggling with a number of emerging risks and challenges, but it is based on sound foundations, such as the credibility of the peg, the level of mandatory reserves and the liquidity situation of banks. These are important aspects that need to be preserved and strengthened, in particular by improving regulation and strengthening supervision. Last but not least, it is also important to view the development of the system in the long term, in line with international best standards and practices and the needs of the economy and society. The Bank of Cape Verde has acted actively in this direction, with a view to consolidating and strengthening the stability of the financial system and the banking sector in particular. In line with this objective, a number of initiatives are currently being advanced to ensure that, even in an adverse context, national banking can continue to better serve the needs of the economy and society. These initiatives include the following: - introduction of a Basic Law of the Financial System, a framework of reference establishing a set of principles applicable to all financial activity in the country. Developed with technical support from the International Monetary Fund, the preliminary draft for this reference framework, based on the best international standards and practices, was recently approved by the Council of Ministers and should soon be considered by the National Assembly; - introduction of a new Banking Law, desperating in the national regime the improvements made at international level since the adoption of the current Law in 1996. The preliminary draft was also recently approved by the Council of Ministers and the final decision on this matter should also be taken by Parliament in the coming months. But reform initiatives are not limited to the banking sector. In order to strengthen and diversify financial activity in the country, the BCV has promoted in the recent past the modernization of legislation applicable to the insurance sector and the securities market. In addition to contributing to the strengthening and boosting of these non-banking financial sectors, these reforms will also have a positive impact on the stability of the banking sector as, by extending the range of financing alternatives, notably more suitable for higher-risk operations, they will help to relieve pressure on banks to finance operations whose characteristics do not suit their funding profile. Along the same lines, but with a broader vision, the BCV is also currently developing, with technical assistance from the World Bank, a strategy and action plan for the development of the financial system. This long-term guidance framework for the BCV on initiatives aimed at the development of the financial system should pay particular attention to non-banking financial activities, in line with the current and forward-looking needs of the national economy, referred to above. It is therefore with the announcement of these important initiatives that I will end my brief reflections, reiterating my congratulations to BES-CV for another anniversary and wishing that it will continue to contribute to further development and further development of the financial system in Cape Verde.
text_original: Interveno do Governador Carlos Burgo no Acto de Comemorao do 3. Aniversrio do BES-Cabo Verde Praia, 8 de Julho de 2013 Exma Administrao do BES-CV Minhas Senhoras e meus Senhores Permitam que as minhas primeiras palavras sejam dirigidas  Administrao do BES-CV, a quem felicito pela passagem do 3. aniversrio da instalao do Banco em Cabo Verde, reconhecendo o importante contributo que este tem dado na dinamizao do sector financeiro em Cabo Verde, nomeadamente atravs da disponibilizao de servios a no-residentes. A entrada do BES-CV em Cabo Verde foi sem dvida um sinal encorajador e de confiana no sector financeiro caboverdiano, que ter ficado mais forte, e uma oportunidade de serem exploradas as potencialidades dos mercados lusfono e da sub-regio africana onde Cabo Verde se insere. Muito me honra poder intervir nessa cerimnia (aproveito, por isso, para agradecer o convite que me foi formulado) e ter a oportunidade de apresentar algumas reflexes sobre as perspectivas econmicas e financeiras de um pas que se v confrontado com enormes desafios, que exigem mudanas estruturais na sua economia, face a uma conjuntura internacional caracterizada por enorme complexidade e riscos elevados para a estabilidade do sistema econmico e financeiro internacional. Comearia, por isso, por relembrar que, para alm da misso principal do Banco de Cabo Verde - a manuteno da estabilidade de preos - outra das suas atribuies fundamentais  a salvaguarda da estabilidade do sistema financeiro, estando actualmente o foco colocado no reforo da regulao e da superviso e na promoo de prticas de gesto ss, que passam pelo aperfeioamento da capacidade de anlise e de gesto de riscos, que devero ser minimizados, bem como na preservao da confiana no sistema. A minha interveno nessas comemoraes d-me igualmente oportunidade de destacar a relevncia da actividade bancria no financiamento da economia, o que justifica o reforo de instrumentos legais e normativos, que se encontram em vias de aprovao, em resposta aos desafios da actual conjuntura internacional e nacional. Minhas Senhores e meus Senhores, Umas das principais lies que se pode extrar da j prolongada crise econmica e financeira internacional  a da importncia de adopo de uma gesto prudente, inserida numa estratgia de permanente antecipao e de minimizao de riscos. Isto porque, no caso da sua materializao, as autoridades vm-se amide confrontadas com territrios desconhecidos, pelo que as medidas correctivas tendem a revelar-se muito mais complexas na sua concepo e execuo, com impactos muito desfavorveis para o bem-estar social. No Banco de Cabo Verde, uma preocupao central tem sido a de identificao, de forma antecipada, dos principais riscos para a economia do pas e para o sistema financeiro, em particular. Um aspecto fundamental, nomeadamente pelo seu impacte transversal/global sobre o conjunto dos sectores institucionais, na ptica da contabilidade nacional, prende-se com a dinmica da actividade econmica e com as suas implicaes sociais, com destaque para o emprego. Os dados disponveis apontam para uma significativa desacelerao da actividade econmica: tal evoluo coloca de forma premente, no centro das prioridades, a questo do potencial de crescimento da economia. Qual ser o valor de referncia mais credvel para o potencial de crescimento da economia? Quais so as actuais e futuras fontes potenciais de crescimento da economia de Cabo Verde? Que e como adoptar medidas adequadas  melhoria deste potencial? Ligada directamente a esta problemtica est a necessidade de melhoria da competitividade econmica, do ambiente de negcios, da qualificao profissional, da legislao laboral e, de uma maneira geral, da reduo dos riscos para a actividade econmica, nomeadamente em relao ao sector privado. Uma gesto virada para a mitigao dos riscos na economia  por conseguinte fundamental. Numa avaliao dos principais riscos para a economia, estes situam-se, na minha perspectiva, no mdio e longo prazos, o que significa que estamos ainda em condies de reforar e/ou adoptar as medidas necessrias para aumento da resilincia da economia do pas, nomeadamente para fazer face  emergncia de choques externos adversos. Isso pressupe, entre outros, a existncia de espao macroeconmico  a nvel oramental e monetrio. Um nvel minimamente adequado de reservas cambiais e um endividamento no excessivo do Estado so duas condies essenciais a respeitar, no quadro do regime econmico vigente no pas, onde a credibilidade e a confiana so fundamentais. Um contexto de fraco crescimento econmico implica menor dinamismo do lado das receitas fiscais para o Estado, impondo necessidade de ajustamento do lado da despesa. Mas as prprias empresas e as famlias tm de fazer ajustamentos para evitar que o seu endividamento e o nvel de endividamento do pas atinjam um nvel excessivo. No que se refere especificamente ao sistema bancrio, importa realar que, de uma maneira geral, os nveis de liquidez e de rentabilidade existentes permitem aos bancos fazer face a muitos dos eventuais riscos emergentes, pese, embora, o facto de, em 2012, os bancos terem enfrentado uma conjuntura difcil, como corolrio do impacto do enquadramento externo sobre a actividade econmica. Apesar do crescimento dos activos, os resultados e a rentabilidade do sector bancrio prosseguiram a anterior tendncia de reduo. A actividade bancria em 2012 aumentou, com os activos lquidos totais a crescerem 11,14%, reflectindo o maior volume de aplicaes em instituies de crdito no pas e no estrangeiro. Os depsitos mantm-se como a principal fonte de financiamento, representando 71% dos recursos, confirmando a reconhecida estabilidade do funding dos bancos e uma situao confortvel em termos de liquidez. A rendibilidade dos capitais prprios e dos activos evidenciou alguma reduo, apontando para um desempenho menos favorvel na gesto dos recursos, comprovado pela significativa reduo da eficincia bancria (rcio cost-to-income) e pela diminuio da margem financeira. No concernente  adequao de fundos prprios, o reforo das provises, face  deteriorao da qualidade da carteira de crdito, implicou uma reduo significativa dos fundos prprios do sistema, o que, acompanhada por um ligeiro aumento dos activos em risco, conduziu  reduo dos rcios. Embora o rcio de solvabilidade do sistema (12,13%) se situe acima do mnimo regulamentar (10%), esta situao aparentemente confortvel no exime os bancos de uma gesto prudente que salvaguarde a solvabilidade e a estabilidade do sistema. Em termos de riscos, o de crdito mantm-se como o principal constrangimento para o sistema, devido principalmente  concentrao nos sectores da habitao e construo e num nmero reduzido de contrapartes. Registou-se uma evoluo desfavorvel da qualidade da carteira de crdito, com o aumento do nvel de incumprimento global, acompanhado, porm, pelo reforo das provises, seguindo a recomendao do BCV. Em relao ao risco de liquidez, o rcio de transformao reduziu-se em 2012, na sequncia do aumento significativo dos depsitos. Tal evoluo traduziu-se numa melhoria do quadro global de liquidez do sistema, registando-se uma tendncia para a restruturao da composio dos activos, no sentido de privilegiar os com maior liquidez. Pode-se, pois, afirmar que o sistema financeiro nacional e, particularmente, o sector bancrio, debate-se com um conjunto de riscos e desafios emergentes, mas encontra-se assente em bases slidas, quais sejam a credibilidade do peg, o nvel das reservas obrigatrias e a situao dos bancos em termos de liquidez. So aspectos importantes que importa preservar e reforar, designadamente pela via da melhoria da regulao e do reforo da superviso. Por ltimo, mas no menos importante, importa ainda perspectivar o desenvolvimento do sistema a longo prazo, em linha com os melhores padres e prticas internacionais e com as necessidades da economia e da sociedade. O Banco de Cabo Verde tem agido activamente nessa ptica, visando consolidar e reforar a estabilidade do sistema financeiro e do sector bancrio em particular. Em linha com este objectivo, est actualmente em fase avanada um conjunto de iniciativas visando garantir que, mesmo num contexto adverso, a banca nacional possa continuar a servir cada vez melhor as necessidades da economia e da sociedade. Entre estas iniciativas, salientam-se as seguintes: - introduo de uma Lei de Bases do Sistema Financeiro, quadro de referncia que estabelece um conjunto de princpios aplicveis a toda a actividade financeira no pas. Desenvolvido com apoio tcnico do Fundo Monetrio Internacional, o anteprojecto para este quadro de referncia, assente nos melhores padres e prticas internacionais, foi recentemente aprovado pelo Conselho de Ministros e dever em breve ser apreciado pela Assembleia Nacional; - introduo de uma nova Lei Bancria, consagrando no regime nacional as melhorias registadas a nvel internacional desde a aprovao da actual Lei, em 1996. O respectivo anteprojecto foi igualmente aprovado recentemente pelo Conselho de Ministros, devendo tambm a deciso final nesta matria ser tomada pelo Parlamento nos prximos meses. Mas as iniciativas de reforma no se circunscrevem ao sector bancrio. Com o objectivo de fortalecer e diversificar a actividade financeira no pas, o BCV promoveu no passado recente a modernizao da legislao aplicvel ao sector segurador e ao mercado de valores mobilirios. Para alm de contribuir para o reforo e dinamizao destes sectores financeiros no bancrios, estas reformas tero tambm um impacto positivo sobre a estabilidade do sector bancrio j que, ao alargar o leque de alternativas de financiamento, designadamente mais adequadas para operaes de maior risco, contribuiro para aliviar a presso sobre os bancos, no sentido de financiar operaes cujas caractersticas no se adequam ao seu perfil de financiador. Nesta mesma linha, mas com uma viso mais ampla, o BCV est tambm actualmente a desenvolver, com assistncia tcnica do Banco Mundial, uma estratgia e um Plano de Aco para o desenvolvimento do sistema financeiro. Este quadro de orientao de longo prazo para o BCV em matria de iniciativas orientadas para o desenvolvimento do sistema financeiro dever dedicar uma ateno especial s actividades financeiras no bancrias, em linha com as necessidades actuais e prospectivas da economia nacional, anteriormente referidas. , pois, com o anncio dessas importantes iniciativas, que termino estas minhas breves reflexes, reiterando as minhas felicitaes ao BES-CV por mais um aniversrio e desejando que continue a contribuir para um maior desenvolvimento e dinamizao do sistema financeiro em Cabo Verde.

Title: Intervention at the inauguration of the new office of mpar
text: Speech of the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde, Carlos Burgo, at the inauguration of the New Administrative Headquarters of impar, August 30, 2013 Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 1 Your Excellency, Prime Minister, Your Excellency, Mr Mayor of Praia, Ladies and gentlemen of the Board of Directors of impar, Ladies and gentlemen Collaborators of Odd, Dear Guests, I am very honored to participate in the inauguration of the New Administrative Headquarters of impar. I would like to congratulate all employees on this gain in these 21 years of commitment, performance and devotion to the insurance cause in Cape Verde. It is good to see impar inaugurating this modern and functional place at the present time, because it is unequivocally a good sign, a sign that the financial institution is a big one, and, above all, with a strong ambition to grow and contribute to the development of the insurance sector, the financial system and the country. In a context where the international crisis has been conditioning the performance of the Cape Verdean economy, especially through the reduction of external financing flows, a very positive aspect is the fact that the financial system, with its functions of facilitating payments, financing investments and enabling risk management, is fulfilling its role of reducing the impact of this shock on the State, businesses and families. As far as the insurance sector is concerned, despite the sensitive impact of the slowdown in economic activities, it is experiencing positive momentum, resulting in part from the persistent search for new businesses, particularly in the non-life sector and in the international sector. The soundness of the sector, measured by the solvency margin, which reached 300 % is comfortable. Without dida that, in order to fully correspond to its role in the development of the Cape Verdean economy, the financial system faces challenges. Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 2 I must reiterate here that the authorities are committed to creating the necessary conditions for the financial system to continue to develop, with enhanced stability. With the approval by the National Assembly, in the first months, of the Basic Law of the Financial System and the Law of Activities and Financial Institutions, we will have completed the process of modernization of financial legislation. The Bank of Cape Verde has been strengthening its supervisory capacity in order to ensure the proper functioning and stability of the system. This is contributing to the transition to risk-based supervision and concern about macro prudential aspects and systemic risks. Action to extend access to financial services, financial training and information and consumer protection of financial services should also be highlighted. I repay my congratulations to the Administration of impar and all its employees, who have made an invaluable contribution to the insurance area in Cape Verde. Thank you very much! Title: Speech at the VII Meeting of the Governors of the Central Banks of portuguese-speaking countries
text: Speech by the Governor of the Bank of Cape Verde, Dr. Carlos Burgo, at the VII Meeting of the Governors of the Central Banks of portuguese-speaking countries, Cidade da Praia, May 2, 2014. Convergence of Regulation and Supervision of Financial Activity  Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 1 Excellency Governor of the National Bank of Angola, Dr. Jose Massano, Excellency, Director of the Central Bank of Brazil, Dr. Luiz Feltrim, Excellency Mr. Governor of BCEAO, Dr Jean Baptiste Campaore Excellency, Governor of the Bank of Mozambique, Dr Ernesto Gove, Excellency Governor of Banco de Portugal, Dr. Carlos Silva, Excellency Governor of the Bank of Timor Leste, Dr. Abrao Vasconcelos, Ladies and gentlemen, Employees of the Bank of Cape Verde, Dear Guests, Let me first welcome the Fellow Governors, Administrators and their delegations and tell you that it is a great honor for the Bank of Cape Verde to host the VII Meeting of the Governors of the Central Banks of the Portuguese-speaking Countries in Praia. I would even say that it is a redoubled honor because the 1st Meeting of Governors also took place on Cape Verdean soil in 2004. The meetings of Governors have been, over these 10 years, real spaces for debate on common, strategic, transversal and fundamental themes to our institutions. The Convergence of Regulation and Supervision of Financial Activity is the central theme of the work of this VII Meeting of the Governors of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries. It is therefore an occasion conducive to the discussion of the various aspects of the convergence process and a privileged opportunity for, within the framework of the Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 2 exchange between our Central Banks, to promote and facilitate a greater ecological and financial approximation of the countries that compm the CPLP. In a particularly difficult economic environment, mainly caused by the impact of the international financial crisis, financial system regulators face enormous challenges linked to the need to make improvements in their way of acting. It is in this context that we have seen a clear trend over the past few years towards the creation of integrated supervisory architectures for the entire financial sector and the strengthening of international cooperation. The main purpose is the search for greater effectiveness and greater convergence of regulatory policies and supervisory practices. In Cape Verde, the modernisation of the regulation and supervision of the financial system is an important aspect of regulatory convergence with the European Union under the Special Partnership. Ladies and gentlemen, The Bank of Cape Verde, which has under its responsibility the supervision of the entire financial system, has been strengthening its regulatory and supervisory capacity, with a view to ensuring the stability and proper functioning of the financial system. This has contributed to the transition to risk-based supervision and concern about macro prudential aspects and systemic risks. As far as regulation is concerned, the legislative and regulatory framework is being updated, strengthening the powers of supervision and clarifying the role of all actors in the financial system. With the recent publication of the Basic Law of the Financial System and the Law of Activities and Financial Institutions, the process of modernization of financial legislation was completed. Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 3 It is also worth mentioning the restructuring and strengthening of the Department of Supervision of Financial Institutions of the Bank of Cape Verde through a new organic structure and a greater qualification of Human Resources. With regard to the Area of Payment Systems stands out the challenge of implementing the superintendence function of Financial Market Infrastructures in order to promote efficiency in the functioning of payment systems and instruments, minimize systemic risk, ensure the maintenance of financial stability, confidence in the central bank's currency and security in the implementation of monetary policy. The Bank of Cape Verde, I would like to highlight, has had the strong commitment and support of the central banks of Portugal and Brazil in this process of modernization and restructuring. With the National Bank of Angola, a protocol was signed in February this year in the area of supervision of financial institutions, in particular in the context of the exchange of information in the areas of regulation and supervision of financial institutions in Angola and Cape Verde. It should be noted that the same agreement exists with Banco de Portugal and translates into visible results in the quality of the supervisory work. Ladies and gentlemen, The international crisis has been conditioning the performance of the Cape Verdean economy, mainly through the reduction of external financing flows, but a very positive aspect is the fact that the financial system, with its functions of facilitating payments, financing investments and enabling risk management, is fulfilling its role of reducing the impact of this shock on the State, businesses and families. Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 4 In an adverse macrofinancial context, and low inflationary pressures and the accumulation of external reserves, a necessary condition for defending the credibility of the unilateral peg regime to the Euro, the Bank of Cape Verde has adopted a moderately accommodative stance in the conduct of monetary policy since mid-2013. The aim of boosting economic activity is one of the reasons that led to the decision. However, as far as this is concerned, the impact will be conditioned both on the behaviour of banking institutions, which are currently experiencing a feeling of high risk aversion, and to measures to restructure companies to reduce debt and enable businesses. Risk-sharing mechanisms, currently under implementation, are likely to contribute to the reorientation of credit for small businesses that have an important weight in the business fabric but traditionally face difficulties in accessing finance. The current situation and financing challenges of the economy in the future require the search for alternative financing solutions and require innovation and the development of the financial system. I must reiterate here that there is a strong commitment from the Bank of Cape Verde, together with its partners, to create the necessary conditions for the Cape Verdean financial system to continue to develop, with ever greater stability. Ladies and gentlemen, The VII Meeting of Governors of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries is therefore a unique opportunity that is offered to us for the exchange of experiences and concerns, sharing of teachings and proposals for a solution Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 5 with a view to increasing and better financial integration of our countries. This is the challenge that will guide us throughout the work of the VII Meeting of Governors of the Central Banks of Portuguese-speaking Countries. Finally, Governors, Administrators, Ladies and Gentlemen, we would like to wish you all an excellent stay in our country and good opportunities to experience the kindness of the Cape Verdean people. Thank you very much! BCV, 2 May 2014 Office of the Governor and the Councils Avenida Amilcar Cabral P.O. Box 101 Phone (238) 2607000 Fax (238) 2614447 Beach - Cape Verde 6
text_original: Interveno do Governador do Banco de Cabo Verde, Dr. Carlos Burgo, no VII Encontro dos Governadores dos Bancos Centrais dos Pases de Lngua Portuguesa, Cidade da Praia, 2 de Maio de 2014. A Convergncia da Regulao e da Superviso da Actividade Financeira  Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 1 Excelncia Senhor Governador do Banco Nacional de Angola, Dr. Jos Massano, Excelncia Senhor Administrador do Banco Central do Brasil, Dr. Luiz Feltrim, Excelncia Senhor Vice Governador do BCEAO, Dr. Jean Baptiste Campaor Excelncia Senhor Governador do Banco de Moambique, Dr. Ernesto Gove, Excelncia Senhor Governador do Banco de Portugal, Dr. Carlos Silva, Excelncia Senhor Governador do Banco de Timor Leste, Dr. Abro Vasconcelos, Senhoras e Senhores Colaboradores do Banco de Cabo Verde, Caros Convidados, Permitamme antes de mais dar as boas vindas aos Colegas Governadores, Administradores e respectivas delegas e dizervos que  uma grande honra para o Banco de Cabo Verde receber o VII Encontro dos Governadores dos Bancos Centrais dos Pases de Lngua Portuguesa na Cidade da Praia. Diria mesmo que  uma honra redobrada pois o I Encontro de Governadores aconteceu tambm em solo caboverdiano em 2004. Os encontros de Governadores tm sido, ao longo destes 10 anos, verdadeiros espaos de debate de temas comuns, estratgicos, transversais e fundamentais s nossas instituis. A Convergncia da Regulao e da Superviso da Actividade Financeira  o tema central dos trabalhos deste VII Encontro dos Governadores dos Bancos Centrais dos Pases de Lngua Portuguesa. Constitui, pois, uma ocasio propcia  discusso dos diversos aspectos do processo de convergncia e uma oportunidade privilegiada para, no mbito do Gabinete do Governador e dos Conselhos Avenida Amlcar Cabral  Caixa Postal 101  Telefone (+238) 2607000  Fax (+238) 2614447  Praia  Cabo Verde www.bcv.cv 2 intercmbio entre os nossos Bancos Centrais, se promover e facilitar uma maior aproximao econica e financeira dos pases que compm a CPLP. Num ambiente econmico particularmente difcil, provocado, sobretudo, pelo impacto da crise financeira internacional, as entidades de regulao e superviso do sistema financeiro enfrentam enormes desafios ligados  necessidade de introduo de melhorias na sua forma de actuao.  neste contexto que temos vindo a assistir nos timos anos a uma clara tendncia para a criao de arquitecturas de superviso integrada para todo o sector financeiro e o reforo da cooperao internacional. O propito principal  a busca de maior eficcia e uma maior convergncia de polticas regulamentares e de prticas de superviso. Em Cabo Verde, a modernizao da regulao e superviso do sistema financeiro  uma vertente importante da convergncia normativa com a Unio Europeia, no mbito da Parceria Especial.
